jobs.title: #136008 - Product Designer - Authentication & Account Security

This role owns small\-to\-mid scoped initiatives from problem framing and exploration through validation, engineering\-ready specifications, implementation quality assurance, and launch, while partnering with senior designers on larger efforts. **Enterprise experience strongly preferred.** **Job Description** * Own end\-to\-end product design for defined authentication and account\-management initiatives. * Frame problems, explore concepts, iterate with partners, and deliver engineering\-ready specifications. * Audit and map current sign\-up, sign\-in, routing, account, and security\-settings experiences. * Identify inconsistencies and seams across related identity and account flows. * Design complex, multi\-path experiences that respond to user and account conditions. * Produce rapid MVP explorations for experimental work. * Deliver responsive web and mobile\-web designs with complete empty, loading, error, edge\-case, and recovery states. * Create redlines, interaction details, and clear implementation documentation for engineering. * Conduct lightweight usability validation and draft interface copy for content review. * Provide design quality assurance through implementation and launch. * Participate in engineering scoping and refinement, reasoning about authentication, verification, session states, routing logic, and system dependencies. * Work within an established design system and extend it responsibly when new patterns are needed. **Qualifications** **Must\-Have Skills** * A portfolio demonstrating strong product and visual design craft, including end\-to\-end web and mobile application flows. jobs.title: AI Research Scientist
jobs.description: **About Absentia Labs** ----------------------- Absentia Labs is building mechanistic AI models to predict how drug compounds will behave in the human body before costly preclinical and clinical studies. Our platform integrates molecular properties, exposure, biological context, experimental evidence, and machine learning to identify potential safety liabilities earlier and explain the biological mechanisms driving them. We initially focus on predictive toxicology and drug safety, with the broader goal of building foundational models that can reason across human biology, pharmacology, and translational outcomes. We work at the intersection of frontier AI, computational biology, chemistry, toxicology, and drug development. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for an AI Research Scientist to help advance the modeling approaches at the core of Absentia's platform. This is a research role for someone who wants to develop new machine learning methods for difficult scientific problems, not simply apply existing models to biological datasets. You will formulate research questions, design and run experiments, develop novel model architectures and learning strategies, and investigate how models can integrate heterogeneous biological and chemical evidence to predict complex human outcomes. Our research problems span molecular representation, graph learning, transformers, multimodal learning, representation learning, uncertainty, mechanistic reasoning, and biological generalization. You will work closely with our CTO, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and scientists to move promising ideas from research hypotheses into validated modeling capabilities. The goal is straightforward but difficult: develop AI systems that can reason about how a drug interacts with human biology well enough to make useful predictions before those outcomes are observed experimentally or clinically. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own ambitious research problems in predictive toxicology, drug safety, and computational biology from hypothesis through experimental validation. * Develop and evaluate novel deep learning architectures and training methods, including graph neural networks, transformers, multimodal models, generative approaches, and other emerging architectures where scientifically appropriate. * Investigate representations that connect molecular structure, biological targets, pathways, dose and exposure, pharmacology, toxicology, and clinical outcomes. * Develop approaches for learning from heterogeneous, sparse, noisy, and partially observed scientific datasets. * Explore methods for cross\-domain and out\-of\-distribution generalization, including prediction on novel compounds, chemical spaces, biological contexts, and endpoints. * Design rigorous experiments, benchmarks, ablations, and evaluation frameworks that distinguish genuine biological generalization from memorization or dataset artifacts. * Develop methods for uncertainty estimation, calibration, applicability\-domain assessment, and confidence\-aware prediction. * Investigate approaches for making model predictions more mechanistically interpretable, including identifying biological pathways, targets, systems, and evidence contributing to predicted outcomes. * Explore multimodal and foundation\-model approaches capable of combining chemical, biological, experimental, literature\-derived, and clinical evidence. * Identify limitations and failure modes in existing models and turn those observations into new research directions. * Work with AI/ML and data engineers to translate successful research into reproducible, scalable modeling systems. * Contribute to Absentia's scientific strategy, including validation studies, external scientific collaborations, publications, and research supporting regulatory evaluation of our models. **Research Problems You Might Work On** --------------------------------------- Rather than hiring against a single architecture, we're interested in researchers who can attack questions such as: * How should a model represent a drug? * Can molecular graphs, learned embeddings, biological targets, metabolites, and pharmacological context be represented jointly rather than as independent features? * How do we model exposure? * Can models reason about how dose, route of administration, metabolism, tissue exposure, and PK/PD change the probability and mechanism of toxicity? * How do we predict beyond the training distribution? * How can we determine whether a prediction for a novel compound represents genuine biological generalization rather than interpolation over known chemistry? * How do we connect mechanisms to outcomes? * Can models learn relationships between molecular interactions, pathways, organ systems, adverse events, and clinical outcomes? * How should uncertainty propagate through biological predictions? * Can we distinguish uncertainty caused by limited chemical similarity, uncertain biological evidence, exposure assumptions, or endpoint ambiguity? * Can one model reason across organ systems? * How should liver, cardiac, renal, and other biological systems eventually interact within a broader model of human drug response? **Who You Are** --------------- You are a researcher who is comfortable working where the correct modeling approach is not yet known. You care about understanding why a model works, where it fails, and whether it is actually learning something generalizable. You are comfortable moving between mathematical ideas, experimental code, scientific literature, and large\-scale empirical results. You can pursue a research direction independently, but you also enjoy working closely with engineers and domain scientists to turn research into systems that matter. Most importantly, you want your research to have consequences beyond a benchmark. **You Likely Have** ------------------- * A PhD in machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer science, computational biology, computational chemistry, applied mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrated research experience. * A strong research track record demonstrated through publications, novel methods, significant open\-source research, or technically substantial research projects. * Deep understanding of modern machine learning and deep learning. * Hands\-on experience developing and evaluating models in PyTorch, JAX, or equivalent frameworks. * Experience with one or more of: graph neural networks, transformers, representation learning, multimodal learning, generative modeling, self\-supervised learning, probabilistic modeling, or foundation models. * Strong experimental instincts and experience designing controlled evaluations, ablations, and reproducible research. * Ability to reason carefully about dataset construction, leakage, confounding, generalization, and evaluation methodology. * Ability to independently identify important research questions and carry projects from initial hypothesis through rigorous experimental results. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Bonus If You Have** --------------------- You do not need to come from drug development or toxicology. We care more about exceptional research ability and the capacity to learn new scientific domains. * Computational biology, computational chemistry, cheminformatics, or drug discovery. * Molecular machine learning or geometric deep learning. * Biological foundation models. * Multimodal scientific machine learning. * Causal inference or mechanistic modeling. * Uncertainty quantification and model calibration. * Out\-of\-distribution/generalization research. * Active learning or experimental design. * Pharmacology, toxicology, PK/PD, or translational science. * Working with large scientific or biomedical datasets. * Research spanning machine learning and the natural sciences. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity participation, allows you to share directly in the long\-term success and growth of the company. * The opportunity to work on foundation\-level ML systems applied to real scientific problems. * Ownership over model design and training strategy, not just implementation. * Close collaboration with data, AI/ML, infrastructure, and scientific teams. * High autonomy, low bureaucracy, and a culture that values technical depth. * Flexible remote or hybrid work arrangements. **How to Apply** ---------------- Please submit your resume and a brief note describing your experience training large\-scale models. Links to GitHub repositories, papers, or technical write\-ups are encouraged. **Our Commitment** ------------------ Absentia Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better systems and stronger science, and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Compensation Range: $130K \- $208K

jobs.title: Assistant Fire Chief
jobs.description: Thank you for considering employment with the City and Borough of Sitka. The following information is provided to give potential applicants awareness regarding the job. **If a range of pay is advertised, starting pay dependent on experience and qualifications aligned with job requirements.** **Primary Purpose of Job \& Essential Duties/Responsibilities** --------------------------------------------------------------- **Primary Purpose of Job** The primary purpose of this position is to manage all fire and emergency services operations and preparedness for fire suppression, fire prevention, emergency medical, natural disasters, air emergencies, search and rescue, and emergency management programs for the Fire Department. This position serves as second in command to the Fire Chief. This position is also designated as the CBS Fire Marshal responsible for conducting life safety inspections and other related duties. Under the supervision of the Fire Chief, the Assistant Fire Chief exercises considerable independent judgement and discretion as a professional with technical expertise to perform the position’s daily tasks and responsibilities within department established policies and procedures. The Assistant Fire Chief directly supervises the Senior Fire Engineer. The Assistant Fire Chief is a management employee who assists and acts in a confidential capacity to the Fire Chief, Municipal Administrator, Assembly, and other department heads who formulates, determines, or effectuates management policies. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Manages and coordinates the activities of staff and volunteers involved in all aspects of emergency operations for the Fire Department * Serves as the Fire Marshal and exercises the authority and administers those responsibilities as assigned by the Alaska State Fire Marshal * Performs fire and life safety inspections of existing buildings and facilities * Serves as a fire/arson investigator, investigating the cause, origin and circumstances of all fires within the CBS and maintaining accurate and detailed records for documentation and prosecution purposes * Prepares detailed records of all case files involved in codes inspections * Initiates and pursues formal enforcement action, as appropriate, to enforce code compliance * Ensures the efficient operations and supervision of all personnel, including the accurate and timely completion of all reports according to prescribed policies and guidelines * Responsible for the development and implementation of training programs and coordinates with state officials to provide desired training * Trains, assigns, prioritizes, supervises, motivates and evaluates the performance of work * Assists the Fire Chief with the annual budget and monitors expenditures during fiscal year * Serves as an incident commander under the Incident Command System * Performs emergency fire protection by responding to fire calls and implements fire suppression techniques to rescue victims and protect private and public property * Provides emergency medical services, including responding to emergency calls, assessing patient’s condition upon the arrival of a scene, implementing emergency patient treatment, transporting patients to a hospital for further examination and ensuring the stability of all individuals at all times * Performs other duties as assigned **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities** ----------------------------------- Knowledge of: * Fire and emergency medical services operations, including the supervision of employees and volunteers performing such operations * Current fire suppression and firefighting techniques, including all related equipment. * Fire and emergency medical services recordkeeping requirements and systems * Fire and emergency medical services vehicles and equipment • Safety practices involved in fire suppression, firefighting, and emergency medical services • Fire and life safety inspections Skills in: * Operating a personal computer and Microsoft software such as Word, Excel, and Outlook and any specialized software for fire and emergency medical services operations * Dealing with a wide range of persons, including situations in which individuals may be upset over some issue involving fire and life safety codes or enforcement of such codes * Presenting technical information and building and life safety code explanations to others in an understandable and productive manner * Investigating fires and fire\-related situations and preparing required reports of such investigations Ability to: * Supervise, coordinate and evaluate the work of others * Recognize and maintain confidential information * Work under extremely stressful situations which result from responding to emergency situations, including the responsibility for remaining calm and carrying out all duties with the recognition of the threat to life and property. * Make determinations as to the best course of action for fighting fires or responding to other related emergenc ire department operations, with management and supervisory experience; and * Possession of upon hire ICS 100 and ICS 700 from FEMA; and * Possession of upon hire EMT I license from the State of Alaska, advanced certification preferred, and * Possession of, or the ability to obtain within 12 months of hire, o Firefighter I and Firefighter II certifications from International Fire Service Accreditation Council or Proboard; and o ICC Fire Inspector I and II certifications; or* Any equivalent combination of experience, education, and training which provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the work. Applicants must complete the physical agility course set out by the department in two (2\) attempts and pass drug test before being hired. **Other Job Requirements or Expectations** * Maintain EMT licenses at highest level while employed with the department * Maintain Firefighter certifications while employed with the department * Maintain Fire Marshal certification while employed with the department * Possession of a valid driver’s license issued by the State of Alaska * Must be willing to work in the evenings, at night, on weekends, and holidays * Must be available to be on\-call 24/7 on rotation with the Fire Chief * Must use appropriate Personal Protection Equipment (“PPE”) * Must remain physically fit and able to perform the physical requirements of a firefighter or EMT Possession of, or the ability to obtain with 24 months of hire: * International Code Council (ICC) Building Plans Examiner certification * Commercial Mechanical Inspector certification **Working Conditions \& Physical Requirements** ----------------------------------------------- Working Conditions: * Works in Fire Hall for about 50% of the time * Works in outside, often in inclement weather and subject to potential personal danger, about 50% of the time * Outdoor work exposes employee to environmental factors such as loud noises, vibrations of hand\-held equipment, small and confined spaces, and known hazards involving water, chemicals, electrical, mechanical, physical substances, and fumes * When rendering medical aid to others, employee may be exposed to blood and body fluids Specific Physical Requirements: * Frequent standing and walking * Occasional climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling * Occasional reaching, lifting, pushing, pulling, grasping, and feeling * Occasional repetitive arm and hand motions * Must have excellent vision acuity, both up close and at a distance including ability to visualize depth perception * Must have excellent verbal and communication skills and hearing capabilities * Must be able to lift, push, or pull up to 20 pounds on a regular basis * Must be able to lift, push, or pull up to 50 pounds on a frequent basis with or without the assistance of proper equipment or with help from another * Must be able to lift, push, or pull up to 180 pounds of force occasionally with or without the assistance of proper equipment or with help from another * Basic swimming skills to perform ice, water, and swift water rescue General Physical Requirements: * Sufficient clarity of speech and hearing or other communication capabilities which permits the employee to communicate effectively, including during emergency situations which may involve a high degree of noise * Sufficient vision or other powers of observation which permits the employee to perform firefighting and emergency medical services and to be aware of all related safety concerns * Sufficient manual dexterity and strength which permits the employee to operate department equipment and lift, push, or pull an individual to safety or for medical treatment * Sufficient personal mobility and physical reflexes which permits the employee to perform all duties involved in firefighting and emergency medical services Please reach out to the City and Borough of Sitka Human Resources Office at the below information if you have any questions or concerns.

In addition to operating and enhancing existing capabilities, this role helps evaluate and adopt emerging platform features that expand the value of enterprise data assets and support the future direction of the Data \& Analytics organization. Job Duties \& Responsibilities Data Engineering \& Integration Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data pipelines, integration frameworks, dimensional and canonical data models, and cloud data warehouse solutions that serve as the foundation for enterprise analytics, reporting, machine learning, and AI capabilities. Build and operate scalable data pipelines utilizing batch, CDC, streaming, API\-based, event\-driven, and log\-based data movement patterns while ensuring reliability, performance, and data quality. Partner with business and technology teams to onboard new data sources, deliver trusted data assets, and establish scalable data engineering solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards. Technical Leadership \& Collaboration Serve as a lead technical contributor on strategic initiatives that rely on enterprise data assets and integration capabilities. Advise project teams on data architecture, integration patterns, platform capabilities, and engineering best practices. Mentor data engineers and promote operational excellence across the Data \& Analytics organization. Collaborate closely with architects, analytics teams, application teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business stakeholders. Identify opportunities to leverage emerging data platform capabilities to improve business outcomes and increase organizational agility. Balance immediate delivery needs with long\-term platform sustainability, scalability, and maintainability. Snowflake Platform Ownership Support and administer core Snowflake platform capabilities including compute management, resource governance, workload optimization, and security controls. Design and maintain role\-based access control (RBAC) frameworks and data access patterns supporting enterprise governance requirements. Evaluate new Snowflake features and capabilities and recommend adoption strategies where appropriate. Help evolve platform capabilities supporting analytics, AI, agentic workflows, semantic models, data products, and future business use cases. Engineering Excellence \& DevOps Establish and promote engineering standards for source control, testing, deployment, documentation, and support. Leverage Azure DevOps for backlog management, source control, release management, and deployment automation. Perform code reviews and provide technical guidance to other team members. Contribute reusable frameworks, templates, utilities, and engineering patterns that improve delivery consistency and speed. Job Specific Skills Advanced SQL development, query optimization, and performance tuning experience. Deep understanding of data modeling concepts including dimensional, canonical, normalized, and denormalized data models. Strong knowledge of data warehousing principles, cloud data platforms, and modern data architecture patterns. Experience designing and supporting enterprise data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data integration solutions. Experience developing trusted, reusable data assets that support analytics, reporting, machine learning, and AI use cases. Strong understanding of data quality, governance, lineage, and metadata management concepts. Strong hands\-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable enterprise cloud data platform. Experience with modern data integration and transformation technologies such as dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, HVR, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent platforms. Experience supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data formats including JSON, XML, Parquet, Avro, and CSV. Working knowledge of Snowflake administration, resource governance, role\-based access control (RBAC), query optimization, and secure data sharing. jobs.title: District Technician I/Johnston County
jobs.description: **Agency** Dept of Transportation **Division** State Hwy Administrator \- Div of Hwys **Job Classification Title** Engineering Technician I (S) **Position Number** 60017739 **Grade** NC07 **About Us** It’s the mission of the NC Department of Transportation to connect people, products and places safely and efficiently with customer focus, accountability, and environmental sensitivity to enhance the economy and vitality of North Carolina. We encourage you to consider joining NCDOT where our work not only serves the citizens of North Carolina but has an impact on our world through all modes of transportation. **Description of Work** Please note that all positions close at 12:00 AM on the posted closing date. You must apply by 11:59 PM prior to the posted closing date. This position reports to the District Engineer for the District 3 office in Johnston County. This position will be working with counties, municipalities, contractors, and field support personnel as the permitting technician to establish compliance with applicable engineering standards and guidelines. The position will review plans for subdivisions, utility installations and roadway improvements. The position will process permits, including driveway, utility and non\-utility encroachment agreements, road additions and abandonments and other records and reports as assigned. The position will interact with local governmental agencies, utility representatives, contractors, property owners, and others to discuss adherence to policies and procedures. The position will answer questions and address complaints from the public by telephone, written correspondence or in person. This position will represent the department in contact with the public, other governmental agencies, and utility companies to inform them of the Department’s plans to respond to complaints or questions and coordinate their activities with those of the Department and the contractor. Coordinates work with private developers, contractors, subcontractors, and state personnel to promote good relations and expedite performance of work. Ability to attain NCDOT certifications for asphalt roadway paving, concrete testing, density, Aggregate and Borrow Pit Sampling, and other certifications as required/needed. Assist contractor’s personnel and other technicians in interpreting approved plans and NCDOT standards and specifications. Serve as liaison between the contractor and the department and between the department and the public. Ability to establish and maintain positive lines of communication between other technicians, engineers, contractors and the public. Should be able to effectively communicate in a clear, concise, organized, and persuasive manner. Ability to work safely in an outside environment with exposure to hazards on construction sites including heights, highway traffic and traversing rough terrain in evaluating highway construction. Must be able to legally operate a motor vehicle. Must be able to perform moderate physical activity including but not limited to walking, climbing, balancing, kneeling and standing. Must be able to lift 50 lbs. Must be able to work nights and weekends as required, on any assigned project within the Division. \*\*\*Offer of employment will be contingent upon successful completion of NCDOT post offer employment evaluation.\*\*\* **Knowledge Skills and Abilities/Management Preferences** Salary Grade and Salary Range: NC07 $37,377 \- $65,408 **Management prefers applicants with the following:** * Experience maintaining standard daily records and reports * Experience working in a team environment to complete assignments * Knowledge and understanding of general concepts, practices, and theories used in construction, construction inspection, and /or construction surveying * Knowledge of standards and specifications and plan reading experience Knowledge and skill in the use of computer equipment, iPad and software * **Minimum Education and Experience** Some state job postings say you can qualify by an “equivalent combination of education and experience.” If that language appears below, then you may qualify through EITHER years of education OR years of directly related experience, OR a combination of both. See the Education and Experience Equivalency Guide for details. **Minimum Education and Experience of Requirement:** Associate's degree in Civil Engineering Technology, Survey Technology or assigned discipline from an appropriately accredited institution; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **If there are no qualified candidates remaining in the applicant pool who meet the minimum Education and Experience or Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required for the position, the agency may consider for this position a trainee who does not meet the minimum requirements.** **In accordance with the Governor’s** **Executive Order 303** **, our agency supports second\-chance employment for individuals who were previously incarcerated or justice\-involved. We invite all potential applicants to apply for positions for which they may be qualified.** **It is important that your application includes all your relevant education and work experience and that you answer all questions associated with the application.** **EEO Statement** T he State of North Carolina is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and dedicated to providing employees with a work environment free from all forms of unlawful employment discrimination, harassment, or retaliation. The state provides reasonable accommodation to employees and applicants with disabilities; known limitations related to pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; and for religious beliefs, observances, and practices. **Recruiter:** Tasha Maria Brown **Email:** DOT\-WorkdayJobRecruitment@ncdot.gov

jobs.title: Engagement Lead
jobs.description: **Engagement Lead** =================== **About Transformworks** ------------------------ Transformworks is an AI implementation partner to the world’s most ambitious investors and operators. We work with companies in critical, operationally complex industries, including healthcare, education, and financial services. Our work includes: * Helping an education organization scale the development of high\-quality curriculum across thousands of schools in the U.S. * Automating paperwork and documentation for a healthcare services company supporting more than 2 million patients, freeing its teams to spend more time helping the people they serve We are profitable, growing quickly, and intentionally lean. We believe AI has fundamentally changed what one exceptional engineer with strong business judgment can accomplish, so we keep teams small, give people real ownership, and reward them based on the value they create. **The Role** ------------ As an Engagement Lead, you will be accountable for the success of our client engagements. You will serve as the primary day\-to\-day partner to client executives and operators while leading a team of Forward Deployed AI Engineers through discovery, development, deployment, and adoption. You will determine what we should build, keep execution moving, and ensure the work produces a measurable business outcome. The best way to think about this role is as a more technical and product\-oriented version of an engagement manager. You will combine structured problem\-solving, product judgment, program leadership, and client relationship management. You will not be expected to write production code, but you must be technically fluent enough to work closely with engineers, understand tradeoffs, and help shape effective AI products. Your job is not simply to deliver the scope. It is to make the client successful, find ways to exceed expectations, and continually identify where else AI can create value across the business. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own client engagements from initial discovery through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact * Serve as the primary day\-to\-day partner to client executives, operators, and technical stakeholders * Learn how the client’s business actually works, including its workflows, systems, constraints, and economics * Translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements, user journeys, priorities, and success metrics * Partner with Forward Deployed AI Engineers to shape the solution and make thoughtful decisions about scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs * Run the execution rhythm across each engagement, including planning, client meetings, decision\-making, risk management, and executive updates * Test solutions with end users, gather feedback, and ensure what we build is useful, trusted, and adopted * Create moments that exceed client expectations through proactive insights, rapid improvements, and thoughtful demonstrations of what is possible * Quantify the operational and financial impact of our work and communicate it clearly to company leadership and investment partners * Identify additional AI opportunities across the client’s business and help turn them into new initiatives * Develop reusable playbooks and practices that improve how Transformworks delivers future engagements * Step into whatever gaps need to be filled to keep the client and internal team moving **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years of experience in management consulting, product management, enterprise implementation, client services, or a similarly demanding operating role * Experience leading complex, high\-stakes projects with multiple stakeholders and an ambiguous path forward * Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish an interesting idea from something users will adopt and a business will value * Structured problem\-solving skills and the ability to turn a messy situation into a clear set of priorities and actions * Executive\-level communication skills, both written and verbal * The confidence to challenge clients constructively, surface difficult issues, and be candid about tradeoffs * Enough technical fluency to understand system architecture, data flows, APIs, model behavior, and AI evaluation at a practical level * Strong commercial instincts and an ability to identify additional ways we can create value for a client * A high degree of ownership. You do not wait for someone else to resolve a problem that could affect the engagement * Comfort managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high bar for detail and follow\-through * Genuine curiosity about how AI can change the way businesses operate You do not need to be an engineer or an AI expert on day one. You do need to learn quickly, work naturally with technical teams, and be willing to develop a real understanding of the systems we build. Experience in healthcare, education, financial services, private equity, or another regulated and operationally complex industry is a plus. **Growth at Transformworks** ---------------------------- You will work directly with the founders and play an important role in shaping how Transformworks serves its clients. As you grow, you will take ownership of larger client relationships, lead multiple engagement teams, help expand strategic accounts, and build the systems and team behind our deployment function. Because we are a small firm growing quickly, advancement is based on demonstrated impact rather than tenure. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * Highly competitive base compensation * Uncapped profit\-sharing tied to the performance of the team * Equity compensation * Health, dental, and vision coverage * Direct ownership of engagements with visible operational and financial impact * Exposure to senior executives, investors, and technical leaders across a range of industries * A small, high\-trust team where initiative, judgment, and client impact are rewarded This role is based in New York City and follows a hybrid collaboration model. Compensation Range: $150K \- $300K

jobs.title: Estimator
jobs.description: #### **Marks Clearing \& Grading, Inc.** Location: Wendell / Greater Raleigh, North Carolina Position Type: Full\-Time #### **Job Summary:** Marks Clearing \& Grading is seeking an experienced and motivated Estimator to join our preconstruction and estimating team. This position plays a critical role in identifying, evaluating, and securing profitable site\-development opportunities throughout our market. The Estimator will be responsible for developing accurate and competitive estimates for heavy civil and site\-development projects, including clearing, mass earthwork, erosion control, storm drainage, water and sewer utilities, aggregate base, concrete, paving, and related scopes of work. #### **Key Responsibilities:** * Prepare complete and accurate estimates for sitedevelopment and heavy civil construction projects as directed by the Chief Estimator. * Review plans, specifications, geotechnical reports, addenda, contracts, and other bid documents to develop a comprehensive understanding of project requirements. * Perform and verify detailed quantity takeoffs for earthwork, utilities, storm drainage, erosion control, paving, concrete, and other civil scopes. * Analyze earthwork quantities, cut/fill balances, haul requirements, material handling, and site logistics. * Develop labor and equipment crews, production rates, durations, and associated costs based on anticipated construction means and methods. * Solicit, evaluate, and level subcontractor and supplier quotations to ensure complete scope coverage and competitive pricing. * Identify scope gaps, constructability concerns, project risks, opportunities, and potential valueengineering alternatives. * Attend prebid meetings and conduct site visits to evaluate existing conditions, access, logistics, haul routes, material sources, and other factors affecting project cost. * Develop bid strategies in collaboration with estimating leadership, operations, and executive management. * Prepare estimate summaries, clarifications, exclusions, qualifications, and final proposals. * Participate in final estimate reviews and clearly communicate assumptions, risks, and opportunities. * Maintain accurate historical pricing, production data, subcontractor information, and estimating records. * Participate in project handoff meetings to ensure a complete transfer of estimating assumptions, commitments, and project strategy to operations. * Review estimated versus actual project performance and incorporate lessons learned into future estimates. * Develop and maintain strong relationships with subcontractors, suppliers, engineers, owners, and other industry partners. * Assist in mentoring and developing Junior Estimators and other members of the preconstruction team. #### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s or Associate degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related field; equivalent heavy civil construction experience will also be considered. Years of experience can also be considered in leu of a degree. * 37\+ years of estimating, project management, project engineering, or field experience in heavy civil or sitedevelopment construction. * Demonstrated knowledge of grading, earthwork, underground utilities, storm drainage, erosion control, paving, and related civil construction activities. * Strong understanding of construction means and methods, equipment capabilities, crew configurations, and production rates. * Ability to independently read and interpret civil construction drawings, specifications, geotechnical reports, and contract documents. * Experience with construction estimating, digital takeoff, and earthwork modeling software including AGTEK and HCSS HeavyBid. * Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other constructionrelated technology. * Strong mathematical, analytical, organizational, and problemsolving skills. * Ability to manage multiple estimates and deadlines simultaneously. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively with estimating, project management, field operations, subcontractors, suppliers, and clients. #### **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to spend time on job sites as needed. * Must be able to sit for extended periods when working on estimates. #### **About Marks Clearing \& Grading Inc** Marks Clearing \& Grading stands as your trusted partner in turn\-key site development. With decades of proven experience, we deliver results you can count on for every project, every time. Safety, integrity, and your satisfaction are at the core of everything we do. Our mission is to deliver high\-production sitework that sets the standard for quality and progress. Our strong backlog never slows us down, we prioritize your project and deliver with urgency. Our speed and reliability make us the go\-to partner across the region. Choose Marks, and you get a team that communicates clearly, prices honestly, and treats your project like it is our own.

jobs.title: Founding Marketer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **MintMCP** helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. **AI\-Native Startup** We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. **Traction** Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You own how MintMCP grows. Turn heavy inbound into measurable, repeatable pipeline across both motions: self\-serve, where an engineer tries the gateway, and sales\-assisted, where security review turns into a company\-wide deal. You own positioning for a technical buyer and demand gen across SEO, AEO, paid, and content. You run a webinar series and a steady stream of campaign experiments, build outbound from the ground up with the AE team, and own the lifecycle that turns signups, trials, and security reviews into pipeline. You also own the numbers: how every channel performs, CAC, payback, and a forecast the team can plan against. What makes this different is how you do it. You will not run every campaign by hand, and you will not wait to hire a team. You orchestrate a fleet of agents to do the research, enrichment, sequencing, follow\-up, content drafts, and reporting, so one marketer covers more ground than a traditional team. Agents take on the repeatable work, so the role can stay broad. This role calls for a senior growth marketer with the range to set the message, pick the highest\-leverage bets, and instrument the funnel, then use agents to run it. The work is to look at a messy funnel, find the bottleneck, design the experiment, ship it the same day, and read the data the next morning. You report to the CEO and work across the GTM team. The role is in person. **About You** * You have built a growth marketing function from zero. You have turned messy demand into measurable pipeline at an early\-stage B2B company, ideally dev\-tools, infra, or security, and you can point to the number. * You have real positioning and messaging instincts for a technical buyer. You can hold a conversation with engineers, security leaders, and AI leaders, and turn it into content and campaigns that land. * You have run demand across multiple channels, some mix of SEO, AEO, paid, lifecycle, and content, and you know how to pick the next lever, not just operate the one you know best. * You have run both a self\-serve PLG motion and a sales\-assist motion into a buying committee, and you know they need different plays. * You own the numbers. You are fluent in attribution and funnel analytics, and you can model CAC, payback, and a forecast the team can plan against. If that is not your background, you partner well with whoever owns it. * You are deeply AI\-native and already use agents to multiply yourself. You have built or directed agentic workflows, not just used AI tools, and you are excited to run a fleet of agents as your team instead of hiring one. * You thrive before the playbook exists. You decide what matters, ship within hours, measure what happened, and change direction without a mature org around you. **Nice to have:** * You have stood up outbound that worked, partnering closely with AEs on targeting, messaging, and sequencing, not just running campaigns on your own. * Experience taking a product upmarket, or repositioning and repricing one. * Having built this once already at an AI\-native company. * Field marketing or events experience. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * The room to define how a fast\-growing infrastructure company goes to market, and to build the first AI\-native growth engine from scratch. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product direction. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Join the Leader in Brain and Mental Health At Amen Clinics Inc./Mindworks Innovations Inc., our vision is bold: to be known as the best brain and mental health company in the world. Every member of our team plays a vital role in making that vision a reality—delivering exceptional care, advancing innovation, and changing lives every day. About Mindworks Innovations, Inc. \& Amen Clinics, Inc. At Amen Clinics, Inc./Mindworks Innovations Inc., we’re proud to be an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) company. That means every employee is also an owner, sharing in the success and growth of the organization. As part of our team, you won’t just be contributing to our mission — you’ll be building long\-term value for yourself and your future. Ownership isn’t just a benefit here; it’s a mindset we bring to everything we do. Amen Clinics are outpatient health care clinics that have been providing mental wellness strategies to patients of all ages since 1989\. We offer patient\-first experiences and customized solutions to an array of behavioral and psychiatric conditions. Amen Clinics employs an array of healthcare professionals across our nationwide locations, including psychiatrists, integrative physicians, nutritionists, therapists, and wellness coaches. These practitioners have diverse educational backgrounds and specialties and are skilled at treating patients in the least harmful, most effective means possible. We use all the tools available to us to help make brain health happen. We believe that a better brain always leads to a better life and that achieving our mission will help to prevent and alleviate suffering, not only for individuals but also for generations of individuals. Job Description and Purpose: The Full Stack Developer will build and enhance web and mobile applications across a range of projects. You will develop user\-facing features, backend services, and integrations using Flutter, Dart, and appropriate web and backend technologies. You will also help implement AI\-powered features using existing models and services. You will work closely with product managers, UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and other developers to deliver reliable, user\-friendly applications. This role focuses on implementing defined features within an established architecture, with guidance from a technical lead on complex design decisions and AI implementation. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain mobile applications for iOS and Android using Flutter and Dart, and contribute to web applications using the project’s established technologies. * Build and maintain backend services, databases, and REST APIs that support application workflows, user accounts, content, and integrations with business systems. * Implement assigned features within an established architecture and recommend practical improvements to usability, maintainability, and performance. * Integrate third\-party APIs and SDKs, including AI services for defined use cases such as summarization, conversational interfaces, or image analysis. * Implement provided prompts, output validation, error handling, and fallback behavior for AI features, with technical guidance where needed. * Run established AI evaluation tests, document unexpected outputs, and help resolve issues using approved criteria and safeguards. * Follow secure coding practices and organizational requirements for authentication, access controls, sensitive data, and approved AI services. * Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, and QA engineers to clarify requirements, review acceptance criteria, and deliver responsive, accessible experiences. * Participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback, document code and integrations, and share knowledge with teammates. * Collaborate with internal and external developers on assigned features and integrations. * Write and maintain automated tests, support existing CI/CD pipelines, and participate in release testing and bug fixes. * Troubleshoot production issues and performance bottlenecks; use application analytics and user feedback to improve reliability and usability. * Participate in Scrum or Kanban planning, estimate assigned work, and communicate progress, risks, and blockers to the project manager or technical lead. Qualifications \& Requirements * 3\+ years of professional software development experience, including user\-facing applications and backend services. * At least 1 year of hands\-on Flutter development experience, with practical proficiency in Dart, state management, asynchronous programming, and API integration. * Experience building a substantial Flutter application; ability to explain implementation decisions, troubleshoot issues, and incorporate code\-review feedback. * Proficiency in a backend language such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js, plus experience developing REST APIs and working with SQL and/or NoSQL databases. * Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and a modern web framework relevant to the project stack. * Basic hands\-on experience integrating an AI model through an API, including handling responses and errors; prototype or project experience is acceptable. * Experience with a cloud or managed backend platform such as Firebase, AWS Amplify, Azure, or a comparable service. * Understanding of object\-oriented programming, reusable components, secure coding, and application performance fundamentals. * Experience with Git\-based version control, debugging, automated testing, and collaborative code reviews. * Ability to work effectively with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and remote development partners. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new technologies. * Familiarity with agile delivery and tools such as Asana or Jira; ability to estimate work and communicate blockers promptly. jobs.title: Healthcare Software Tester / QA Specialist (Healthcare Experience Preferred)
jobs.description: Healthcare Software Tester / QA Specialist (Healthcare Experience Preferred) **Company:** PillarThera **Location:** La Palma, California — Local candidates preferred within approximately 5 to 10 miles **Work Arrangement:** Part\-Time / Contract; On\-Site preferred **Training:** In\-person in La Palma preferred **(A) About PillarThera:** PillarThera is an AI\-powered home\-based care platform designed to connect patients, independent healthcare providers, and healthcare agencies while simplifying care coordination \& delivery, clinical documentation, scheduling, compliance, billing, and claims workflows. The platform supports healthcare professionals including: * Physical Therapists (PT) * Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) * Occupational Therapists (OT) * Occupational Therapy Assistants (OTA) * Speech Therapists / Speech\-Language Pathologists (ST/SLP) * Registered Nurses (RN) * Licensed Vocational Nurses / Licensed Practical Nurses (LVN/LPN) * Nurse Practitioners (NP) * Certified Nursing Assistants (CNA) * Caregivers We are looking for a hands\-on **Healthcare Software Tester / QA Specialist** who can test PillarThera (Website, Android, and iOS) from the perspective of real healthcare users. **(B) Who We Are Looking For:** We strongly prefer candidates who have worked in the healthcare industry and have hands\-on experience using healthcare software. *Note: You do* ***not*** *need to be a software developer or professional QA engineer.* Ideal candidates may have experience as a healthcare provider, medical biller, healthcare administrator, agency staff member, clinical coordinator, intake specialist, authorization specialist, or similar healthcare professional. Experience using healthcare software for any of the following is especially valuable: * Patient intake and registration * Healthcare provider or agency account registration and administration * Electronic medical records or healthcare management systems * Scheduling and patient visits * Clinical documentation \- AI automation and manual review * Plan of Care (POC) workflow \- preparation, submission, certification, tracking, approval/rejection. * Insurance eligibility or benefits verification * Prior authorization * Medical billing and claims submission * Claims status and payment tracking * Provider credentialing * Electronic signatures and healthcare documents * Home health, therapy, skilled nursing, or caregiving workflows **(C) What You Will Test:** You will test PillarThera from different user roles and follow realistic healthcare workflows through the system. Depending on the testing assignment, this may include: **(1\) Patient Portal** Testing patient registration, profile setup, insurance information, service requests, provider search and matching, scheduling, documents, payments, messaging, and other patient functions. **(2\) Provider Portal** Testing provider registration, professional credentials, license and NPI information, patient/case workflows, scheduling, clinical documentation, visit\-related functions, billing, claims, payments, and other provider functions. **(3\) Agency Portal** Testing agency registration and setup, administrators, provider/workforce management, patient management, credentialing, case assignments, documentation, claims, billing, compliance, and agency workflows. **(4\) Certifier / Clinical Workflow** Testing Plan of Care review, certification\-related workflows, documentation, approvals, signatures, and communication between healthcare roles. **(5\) Administrative \& Compliance Functions** Testing user management, verification, subscriptions, transactions, documents, compliance\-related functions, system notifications, and other administrative workflows. You may also test PillarThera's AI\-assisted and workflow automation features as they become available. **(D) Key Responsibilities:** You will: * Follow provided test scenarios and test PillarThera functions step by step. * Test the system from different user roles. * Create realistic test accounts and test data when instructed. * Verify whether each function works as expected. * Identify bugs, confusing workflows, missing information, incorrect calculations, or unexpected system behavior. * Evaluate whether workflows make sense from a healthcare user's perspective. * Test on common web browsers and devices when requested. * Re\-test functions after developers make corrections. * Clearly identify whether an issue has been fixed or still exists. * Provide practical feedback on usability and healthcare workflow. * Participate in training and testing meetings in person or through Google Meet. **(E) Test Reporting:** Candidates should be comfortable preparing short, clear test reports. You do not need to write lengthy technical reports. For each issue, you should be able to document: * User Role being tested * Function / Page being tested * Test steps * Expected result * Actual result * Pass / Fail * Description of the problem * Screenshot or screen recording show comfortable using screenshot and screen\-recording tools and sharing the results with our development team. **(F) Required Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience using computers, websites, and software applications. * Comfortable learning and testing a new web\-based healthcare platform. * Able to follow workflows and written testing instructions carefully. * Detail\-oriented and able to recognize when software behavior does not match the expected workflow. * Able to clearly describe software problems in writing. * Able to capture and share screenshots and/or short screen recordings. * Able to organize testing results by function and user role. * Good written and verbal communication skills. * Comfortable communicating with the PillarThera product and development teams. **(G) Healthcare Experience — Strongly Preferred** We strongly prefer candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas: * Physical therapy, occupational therapy, or speech therapy * Skilled nursing * Home health * Home care / caregiving * Medical billing and claims * Insurance authorization * Healthcare administration * Patient intake and scheduling * Provider credentialing * Clinical documentation Licensed or experienced healthcare professionals—including **PT, PTA, OT, OTA, ST/SLP, RN, LVN/LPN, NP, CNA, and caregivers—are encouraged to apply.** Healthcare administrative professionals with strong hands\-on software experience are also encouraged to apply. **(H) Preferred Qualifications:** Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: * EHR/EMR software * Home health or home care software * Practice management software * Medical billing or claims software * Insurance eligibility and prior authorization systems * Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) * Clinical documentation software * Provider credentialing systems * CMS\-1500 or electronic healthcare claims * Healthcare scheduling systems * Bug/issue tracking software Formal software QA certification is **not required**. **(I) Location Preference:** We prefer candidates located in **La Palma, California, or within approximately a 5 to 10\-mile radius**, because some initial training, workflow reviews, and testing sessions may be conducted in person. Qualified candidates outside the area may also be considered. Training and testing meetings can be conducted through **Google Meet** when appropriate. **(L) What Makes Someone Successful in This Role:** The ideal candidate is someone who can look at PillarThera and think: ***“If I were actually using this system to manage a patient, document a visit, obtain authorization, submit a Plan of Care, create a claim, or manage a healthcare provider, would this workflow make sense and work correctly?”*** We value practical healthcare experience and attention to detail as much as traditional software testing experience. **(K) How to Apply:** Please submit your resume along with a brief description of: * Your healthcare experience or healthcare\-related role. * Healthcare software you have used and what you used it for. * Your experience with medical billing, insurance authorization, Plan of Care, clinical documentation, scheduling, or healthcare administration, if applicable. * Your experience testing websites or software, if any. * Your general availability for part\-time or project\-based testing. * **Your current employment status** — Please indicate whether you are currently working full\-time, part\-time, as a freelancer, or as an independent contractor. If currently employed or contracted, please provide the company/organization name and your role. * **Your interest in future opportunities with PillarThera** — After gaining hands\-on experience with PillarThera through the software testing process, would you be interested in being considered for a part\-time or full\-time position with PillarThera before or after our official launch? **PillarThera — Your Pillar for Care and Recovery.** Pay: $15\.00 \- $18\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Infrastructure Administrator
jobs.description: Join the Leader in Brain and Mental Health At Amen Clinics Inc./Mindworks Innovations Inc., our vision is bold: to be known as the best brain and mental health company in the world. Every member of our team plays a vital role in making that vision a reality—delivering exceptional care, advancing innovation, and changing lives every day. About Mindworks Innovations, Inc. \& Amen Clinics, Inc. At Amen Clinics, Inc./Mindworks Innovations Inc., we’re proud to be an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) company. That means every employee is also an owner, sharing in the success and growth of the organization. As part of our team, you won’t just be contributing to our mission — you’ll be building long\-term value for yourself and your future. Ownership isn’t just a benefit here; it’s a mindset we bring to everything we do. Amen Clinics are outpatient health care clinics that have been providing mental wellness strategies to patients of all ages since 1989\. We offer patient\-first experiences and customized solutions to an array of behavioral and psychiatric conditions. Amen Clinics employs an array of healthcare professionals across our nationwide locations, including psychiatrists, integrative physicians, nutritionists, therapists, and wellness coaches. These practitioners have diverse educational backgrounds and specialties and are skilled at treating patients in the least harmful, most effective means possible. We use all the tools available to us to help make brain health happen. We believe that a better brain always leads to a better life and that achieving our mission will help to prevent and alleviate suffering, not only for individuals but also for generations of individuals. Job Description and Purpose: The Infrastructure Administrator is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, maintaining, and securing the company’s on\-premises and cloud infrastructure, including Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud. This role combines hands\-on systems and network administration with cloud engineering to support reliable, scalable technology services across a healthcare organization. The engineer supports servers, networks, identity services, storage, backups, security platforms, and business applications. Working independently and with IT colleagues, application teams, database administrators, and managed service providers, this person resolves complex issues, improves operations, and follows projects and incidents through to completion. Strong attention to detail, customer service, and protection of sensitive patient information are essential. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: * Design, integrate, implement, and support infrastructure solutions; develop deployment plans, operational procedures, and training materials. * Configure, maintain, patch, monitor, and troubleshoot physical and virtual Windows Server environments, including Hyper\-V clusters, storage, and supporting services; support Linux cloud workloads as needed. * Administer Azure compute, storage, virtual networking, identity, monitoring, and backup services; configure and support hybrid connectivity and infrastructure, platform, and software services. * Deploy and administer Google Cloud resources, including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC networks, IAM, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging; support managed services used by application and data teams. * Manage cloud resource organization, permissions, policies, budgets, and usage; identify opportunities to improve availability, capacity, performance, and cost. * Install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, VPNs, and network printers; maintain VLANs, routing, DNS, DHCP, and connectivity across offices and cloud environments. * Administer Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), Group Policy, and hybrid identity integration; manage user accounts, permissions, distribution lists, security groups, and Microsoft 365 services. * Implement and maintain daily backups for business\-critical on\-premises and cloud systems; investigate failures, perform restorations, and test disaster recovery procedures against agreed recovery objectives. * Maintain endpoint protection, antivirus, and endpoint detection and response platforms; support vulnerability remediation, security hardening, access reviews, and incident response with security partners. * Review system, application, network, and security logs; configure monitoring and alerts, investigate incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and document corrective actions. * Monitor and troubleshoot database instances with the DBA and application teams; investigate performance issues and perform approved ETL tasks, data transfers, and scheduled job troubleshooting. * Assist with configuration, administration, and troubleshooting of the ShoreTel VoIP system and related voice networking, coordinating with vendors as needed. * Provide escalation support to service desk and applicatio zure and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and troubleshooting. * Strong hands\-on Windows Server administration and troubleshooting skills across physical and virtual environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Hyper\-V. * Experience maintaining current Windows Server environments and supporting or migrating legacy Windows Server 2008, 2012, 2016, and 2019 systems where present. * Strong understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, including VLANs, trunking, TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, VPNs, and protocols such as OSPF and EIGRP. * Experience administering Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identities, Microsoft 365, multifactor authentication, and role\-based access controls. * Experience administering backups and successfully restoring systems and data; understanding of disaster recovery planning and recovery testing. * PowerShell scripting experience and familiarity with Azure CLI, Google Cloud CLI, and infrastructure automation. * Ability to monitor and troubleshoot database services and support approved SQL queries, ETL processes, and scheduled jobs in collaboration with database specialists. * Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements and the ability to follow organizational policies for protecting sensitive and protected patient information. * Ability to prioritize competing tasks, meet deadlines, interpret technical instructions and diagrams, and follow incidents and projects through to resolution. * Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills; ability to communicate effectively in written and spoken English with technical and nontechnical audiences. * Demonstrated integrity, transparency, confidentiality, and attention to detail when working with employees, leadership, vendors, and auditors. Preferred Qualifications * Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator Associate, Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer, CCNA, or comparable current cloud or networking certifications. * Prior service desk experience and experience supporting a healthcare organization with multiple locations. * Experience with Terraform, Bicep, Git\-based change control, and basic Linux administration. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Sage 100, ShoreTel VoIP, and Dell Unity storage arrays. * Experience with Backup Exec, Datto, or comparable backup and disaster recovery platforms. * Experience with Hyper\-V clustering, cloud migrations, high\-availability configurations, and infrastructure security audits. jobs.title: Junior DevSecOps Engineer (AWS, Automation)
jobs.description: At Peregrine Advisors, you will help build and operate the secure delivery pipelines that carry federal systems into production. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $80,000 to $95,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public. **Your first project** Your first assignment will likely have you working alongside engineers on the pipelines a team relies on every day. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build and maintain pipelines whose builds, tests, and deployments are routine rather than events. * Add automated security testing, including static and dynamic application security testing and software composition analysis, to the delivery path. * Set up monitoring and logging, and map controls to National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800\-53 (NIST SP 800\-53\). * Chase down findings and fix them, which is the fastest way to get good at this. You deliver automation that people review and explain, so you learn why a change is right and not only that it works. You automate what the team does by hand, and you build your part of the practice that puts security in early rather than bolting it on. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 1\+ years of software development, platform, or operations engineering experience * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field * Scripting ability (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) * Working knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) concepts, with hands\-on experience in at least one pipeline tool * Familiarity with cloud services on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and with containerization * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code (CloudFormation or Terraform) * Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Exposure to FISMA compliance, NIST SP 800\-53 controls, or Authority to Operate (ATO) processes * Vulnerability scanning or security tooling experience (SAST, DAST, or policy\-as\-code) * Hands\-on delivery of production workloads on Amazon Web Services (AWS), or an AWS certification * Federal information technology experience * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You treat security and reliability as part of the build, not a gate at the end, and you are highly motivated to develop as an engineer who automates what others do by hand and leaves an audit trail behind. You ask when you are stuck rather than guessing, you take feedback as the fastest route forward, and when priorities shift, you shift with them. You communicate clearly, adapt across roles and clients, and care about creating public value. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A foundation in scripting, cloud fundamentals, and delivery automation, and a real appetite to go deeper on the security side. * The delivery habits, or the willingness to build them fast: version control, automated testing, code review, and secure configuration. * The communication to say clearly what you have done, what you are stuck on, and what you need. * The precision to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.* **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer

Candidates are not expected to have professional experience with every technology listed. andmaintain clear and reliable software using sound engineering principles and appropriate responsibility boundaries. * Build backend services, integrations, APIs, and user interfaces within SCG Tech Solutions' technology environment. * Create andmaintain meaningful automated tests, debug systematically, and verify software behavior using evidence and testable hypotheses. * Work with application interfaces, relational data, validation, error handling, and basic data\-quality safeguards. * Use version control and collaborative code review to support traceable, reviewable, and maintainable software changes. * Apply secure development and software configuration practices, includingappropriate handling of credentials, secrets, access, dependencies, and environment\-specific settings. *
