decisions, assumptions, blockers, risks, and escalation needs clearly while collaborating with technical and business stakeholders and contributing to continuous improvement. **Required Qualifications** * Strong problem\-solving and requirements reasoning, including the ability to identify assumptions, constraints, missing information, edge cases, and practical trade\-offs. * Ability to write, read, debug, explain, and improve software using at least one modern programming language, with working knowledge of core software design principles. * Understanding of common data structures, basic algorithmic and complexity reasoning, and how software choices affect correctness and maintainability. * Understanding of software testing and debugging, including unit and integration testing and familiarity with Test\-Driven Development principles. * Working knowledge of application interfaces, SQL, relational database concepts, data validation, and foundational web application concepts. * Working knowledge of version control and collaborative code review, plus basic understanding of software configuration, development environments, logs, deployment, and controlled software delivery. * Basic understanding of secure coding and the appropriate handling of credentials, sensitive information, dependencies, and access. * Ability to use AI\-assisted development tools responsibly while understanding and validating the software produced. * Strong communication, accountability, curiosity, coachability, intellectual honesty, and willingness to learn from feedback. **Education:** A completed bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, IT/IS with substantial software\-development coursework, or a related field is strongly preferred. Equivalent demonstrable software\-development preparation may also be considered. **Preferred Qualifications** * Internship, capstone, research, open\-source, freelance, personal\-project, or professional evidence of building software applications or services. * Exposure to one or more technologies in our environment, such as Python, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, or comparable technologies. * Experience with software projects involving significant data processing, data integration, data engineering, or data\-quality concerns. * Exposure to logistics, transportation, fleet operations, supply chain, or related industries. * Familiarity with GIS, geospatial data, mapping, routing, or location\-based applications. * Exposure to Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, containers, automated delivery pipelines, observability, or production environments. * Exposure to AI/ML integrations, AI\-assisted software development, or AI\-enabled application capabilities. **Work Authorization and On\-site Requirement** This is a full\-time, on\-site position in Fort Worth, Texas. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. SCG Tech Solutions does not provide employment\-based immigration sponsorship for this position. **Why Join SCG Tech Solutions** You will join a growing engineering team building software for real transportation and logistics operations. The work is not limited to isolated exercises or internal demos. You will contribute to applications, integrations, automation, data\-intensive systems, and AI\-assisted solutions that support real business processes and production environments. As an early member of the software engineering team, you will work across multiple parts of the software delivery lifecycle, collaborate directly with Technology Leadership and business stakeholders, and develop broader engineering judgment as your capability, delivery quality, and independence grow. Our on\-site environment in Fort Worth supports close collaboration, faster access to operational context, and direct interaction with the people who use and depend on the software we build.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: We have been retained by a well\-established and growing insurance provider. What makes this opportunity unusual is that this is not an early\-stage startup. The company is a long\-established, profitable business with a national customer base, strong domain expertise, real production data, and a very clear set of operational problems to solve. They are now building an internal software capability for the first time, and this person will be the first engineer. The initial mandate is to build the software layer that sits above the company’s existing systems of record: data\-dense operating dashboards, workflow tools, third\-party integrations, and supporting backend services. The goal is to replace manual processes and spreadsheet\-heavy workflows with software that operators will actually want to use every day. This role has substantial autonomy. You would work directly with the President and business leaders, shape the technical approach, make architecture decisions, build the first production application, and establish the foundation for how software is developed internally going forward. They are especially interested in someone strong in React/TypeScript, full\-stack development, API integrations, and end\-to\-end product ownership. Experience in insurance, payments, lending, claims, healthcare, or another regulated environment is helpful but not required—the priority is finding an exceptional engineer who can understand a business problem and turn it into reliable, thoughtful software. The engineer will own the design, construction, and operation of the internally developed software, including: **Front\-end applications and operating dashboards.** Data\-dense interfaces covering claims, contracts, dealer performance, and the operational metrics on which the business is managed. **Third\-party integrations.** Connections to the underlying administration platform's published API, dealer management systems, and additional services as requirements expand. **Supporting backend services.** The data services, caching, and business logic that sit between systems of record and the user\-facing application. **Internal tooling and automation.** Replacing work currently performed manually between disconnected systems. The initial deliverable is a functioning front\-end application operating against live production data. **Required qualifications** * Demonstrated strength in modern front\-end engineering, including React or a comparable framework and TypeScript, with experience building performant data\-dense interfaces * Substantial experience integrating with third\-party APIs, including systems with incomplete documentation or inconsistent behavior; competence in authentication, rate limiting, error handling, and failure recovery * Full\-stack capability sufficient to own the path from external service call through to rendered interface * A record of owning software end to end — architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation. This role has no engineering leadership above it * The judgment and communication skills to work directly with non\-technical leadership: translating operational problems into technical plans, and identifying where a proposed approach will not work **Preferred qualifications** * Experience in a regulated or financially sensitive domain — insurance, payments, lending, claims processing, or healthcare billing * Business\-to\-business software used daily by non\-technical users in time\-sensitive settings * Prior experience as the first or sole engineer in an organization Pay: $140,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: MLOps Engineer
jobs.description: About the team **AI Platform scales SPREEAI's infrastructure:** productionizing ML model checkpoints, running the API services behind the Partner Portal, optimizing inference serving, and giving ML Scientists training\-as\-a\-service so they can iterate without managing infrastructure themselves. About the role **This role owns the ML lifecycle platform end to end:** training pipelines, experiment tracking, CI/CD for models, monitoring, and data versioning, so ML Scientists can launch, monitor, and iterate on training runs without managing infrastructure directly. As the Science team expands into Video Try\-On and AI Sizing, this platform is what keeps that research moving fast without breaking. What you'll do **Design and operate training\-as\-a\-service infrastructure:** a scientist should be able to launch a multi\-GPU training job, track metrics, and get notified on completion without touching infra directly **Build CI/CD for models:** automated eval gates that block a bad checkpoint from reaching production, canary rollout, A/B testing hooks Own experiment tracking (Weights \& Biases, MLflow, or Neptune) and data versioning (DVC, LakeFS, or Delta Lake) for datasets in the terabytes that change weekly Monitor training job health (GPU utilization, loss curves, OOM detection) and drive cost governance (spot instances, preemptible VMs, budget alerts) as training costs scale Partner directly with ML Scientists to translate workflow pain points (reproducibility, experiment comparison, checkpoint recovery) into platform abstractions Evaluate and integrate external model providers (SPREEAI uses Byteplus and Fireworks.AI as MaaS providers) into the training and eval platform What you'll bring **Experience building or operating an ML platform:** training orchestration (Ray, Kubeflow, Airflow, or a custom solution), Docker, Kubernetes (Jobs/CronJobs, Helm) Python or Go for pipeline orchestration and infrastructure tooling Real experience with experiment tracking and data versioning tools at production scale Comfort owning platform direction, not just executing tickets, and mentoring engineers as the team scales Comfort with broad ownership across the ML lifecycle in an early\-stage, fast\-moving environment You'll thrive here if You treat ML Scientists as your customers and actively design the boundary between platform responsibility and scientist responsibility rather than letting it happen by accident. You can make the case for a platform investment that isn't obviously urgent yet, and you're comfortable saying no to a feature request that would compromise platform integrity. SPREEAI is a fast\-growing, innovative AI company at the forefront of fashion and e\-commerce, revolutionizing how consumers engage with fashion through lifelike photorealistic try\-on technology and hyper\-personalized shopping experiences. Our mission is to redefine the retail landscape with cutting\-edge AI solutions that blend high fashion and technology. We thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment where creativity meets technology to drive real impact. If you are passionate about innovation and shaping the future of fashion, SPREEAI offers a platform to make your mark. **.css\-16e3h2y{font\-weight:** normal;margin: 0;padding: 0;color: var(\-color\-on\-surface, \#000000\);font\-family: "ripplingFontMedium";font\-size: 15px;letter\-spacing: 0\.25px;line\-height: 22px;display: block;} **The pay range for this role is:** **.css\-1xnp5ym{font\-weight:** normal;margin: 0;padding: 0;color: var(\-color\-on\-surface, \#000000\);font\-family: "ripplingFontLight";font\-size: 15px;letter\-spacing: 0\.5px;line\-height: 22px;display: block;} 145,000 \- 180,000 USD per year (Hybrid (San Francisco, California, US))

jobs.description: **Job Description** **Manufacturing Engineer II** **Pay Range**: $77,000 \- $97,000 depending on relevant experience and qualifications **Location:** Phoenix, AZ 85034 **Work schedule:** Primarily Monday – Friday day shift (Roughly 7:00am – 4:00pm) but flexibility required as needed \& may include Saturday work for projects The Manufacturing Engineer II is responsible for improving manufacturing processes, supporting production operations, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance. This role works cross\-functionally with production, quality, maintenance, supply chain, and product engineering teams to implement efficient and scalable manufacturing solutions. The Manufacturing Engineer II applies intermediate\-level engineering knowledge to troubleshoot production issues, optimize workflows, support new product introductions, and ensure manufacturing systems meet operational and business objectives. **Responsibilities** * Analyze and improve manufacturing processes for efficiency, quality, and safety * Develop and implement process improvements using Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles * Support daily production operations by troubleshooting process and equipment issues * Design and maintain manufacturing work instructions, process Experience with root cause analysis tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone, or FMEA * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical jobs.title: Product Manager – Firmware OTA & Lifecycle Management (Job ID 3022037)
jobs.description: **Locations and Workstyle:** **Irving, TX** and **Boca Raton, FL**: Hybrid schedule – onsite a minimum of four days per week, with one remote day. Five days onsite may be required based on business needs. **Blue Bell, PA**: Primarily remote; candidates should be within commuting distance of the Blue Bell office and able to work onsite as needed. Option to come onsite more frequently if desired. We are looking for a Product Manager to own the end\-to\-end firmware release lifecycle across our connected product platforms. In this role, you will partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Security, Quality, Operations, Customer Care, and external partners to ensure devices remain secure, reliable, current, and supportable throughout their lifecycle. You will serve as the central owner for release planning, over\-the\-air (OTA) deployment strategy, adoption, and post\-release performance. Success in this role requires balancing customer impact, security priorities, operational risk, and business objectives while driving disciplined execution across multiple stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex operational challenges, coordinating across teams, and using data to improve release outcomes. What You’ll Do * Develop integrated release plans covering validation, security reviews, certifications, dependencies, communications, operational readiness, and deployment milestones. * Lead release readiness reviews and establish rollout stages, customer segmentation strategies, success criteria, rollback plans, and escalation procedures. * Coordinate release execution across Engineering, Security, Quality, Customer Care, Field Operations, and external partners. * Monitor deployment health, adoption, update success and failure rates, version distribution, and exception trends. * Create dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into release performance, customer impact, and operational risk. * Drive recovery efforts for unsuccessful or stalled deployments and ensure issues are resolved through closure. * Lead post\-release reviews, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Serve as the primary owner and coordination point for legacy OTA platforms and migration\-related activities. * Translate technical risks and system behavior into clear business impacts and customer\-facing recommendations. * Manage vendor relationships, release dependencies, service expectations, and escalations. What You’ll Need * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Product Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Program Management, Device Lifecycle Management, or a related field. * Experience coordinating customer\-facing software or firmware releases across cross\-functional teams. * Experience defining release requirements, rollout plans, readiness criteria, deployment metrics, and escalation processes. * Working knowledge of embedded firmware, connected\-device ecosystems, OTA update systems, cloud services, and release pipelines. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to assess risk and make data\-driven decisions. Compensation \& Benefits: The salary range for Engineer I is $88,000\.00 – $132,000\.00 based on experience and qualifications. Certain roles are eligible for annual bonus and may include equity. These awards are allocated based on company and individual performance. We offer employees access to healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan and company match, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits and paid time off among others. Employees accrue up to 120 hours in their first year. Your accrual rate increases after your first year. We also offer 6 paid holidays. *In the event a position is commission\-based, compensation is solely based on the individual’s sales volume. This applies only to commission roles.* Los Angeles Applicants: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Philadelphia Applicants: Background checks will be conducted during the employment process. Any information will be reviewed through an individualized assessment in accordance with the Philadelphia Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance. ***ADT is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. ADT strives to ensure every employee and applicant feels valued. Visit us at jobs.adt.com/diversity to learn more.***

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Purpose:** The Project Engineer supports the Project Manager in coordinating the technical, administrative, and field\-related requirements of ABI’s concrete and public infrastructure projects. This position assists with project documentation, material procurement, subcontractor coordination, scheduling, cost tracking, change management, and closeout activities to help ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contract requirements. The Project Engineer serves as an important link between the field and office and helps maintain effective relationships with clients, general contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, engineers, inspectors, public agencies, and other project stakeholders. **Responsibilities:** Project Coordination and Communication * + Support the Project Manager with the day\-to\-day coordination and administration of assigned projects. + Serve as a point of contact for clients, general contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, engineers, inspectors, and other project stakeholders regarding administrative and technical project matters. + Assist with requests for information, submittals, scope clarifications, scheduling questions, field coordination, and other project correspondence. + Maintain clear and timely communication between the Project Manager, field supervision, project owner or general contractor, and internal support functions. + Attend project meetings, document action items, and follow through on assigned responsibilities. + Coordinate with the client or general contractor to confirm that upcoming work areas are available and ready for ABI’s crews. Plans, Specifications, and Document Control * + Review and understand project plans, specifications, addenda, geotechnical reports, contracts, schedules, and other project documentation. + Maintain current plans, specifications, sketches, RFIs, submittals, and other project documents so that field and office personnel are working from the most current information. + Communicate plan revisions, scope changes, and update project requirements to the Project Manager and field supervision. + Prepare plan takeoffs, quantity calculations, and support documentation for material procurement, production planning, and change management. + Assist in maintaining accurate field records, schedules, as\-built information, photographs, and other documentation required to support project execution and closeout. Submittals and RFIs * + Prepare, submit, distribute, and track RFIs, product data, mix designs, shop drawings, samples, and other required submittals through final approval. + Review submittals and shop drawings for general conformance with contract documents before forwarding them for approval. + Monitor outstanding RFIs and submittals and follow up as necessary to prevent project delays. + Distribute approved submittals and related information to the Project Manager, field supervision, suppliers, and other appropriate parties. Materials, Purchasing, and Subcontractor Coordination * + Assist with purchasing and releasing materials for production and delivery in accordance with project plans, specifications, schedules, and contract requirements. + Obtain and evaluate material and subcontractor quotations, prepare bid or purchase comparison information, and make recommendations to the Project Manager. + Compile subcontractor bid packages and assist with the preparation and administration of subcontracts and purchase orders. + Order and track materials to help ensure deliveries support the project schedule and field production requirements. + Coordinate with suppliers regarding approved materials, fabrication schedules, delivery requirements, and required documentation. Field Coordination and Project Controls * + Maintain a regular presence in the field to understand project conditions, observe progress, and support coordination between field and office personnel. + Track crew activities, quantities installed, production progress, material usage, and field conditions to support accurate schedules, cost reporting, and as\-built documentation. + Collaborate with the Project Manager and field supervision on short\-term planning and overall project schedules. + Help identify potential scheduling conflicts, scope gaps, material delays, and other issues that could affect safety, production, quality, cost, or project completion. + Elevate project risks and concerns promptly to the Project Manager and assist with developing and implementing solutions. + Support quality\-control activities and help verify that completed work conforms to contract documents, approved submittals, and applicable standards. + Coordinate utility mark\-outs, permits, inspections, testing, and required notifications as applicable to the project. Cost Management and Change Orders * + Assist the Project Manager with cost coding, production tracking, quantity reporting, committed costs, budget updates, forecasts, and preparation for , and resolution of payment\-related questions. Project Closeout * + Coordinate and maintain project closeout documentation, including as\-built plans, warranties, guarantees, certifications, testing reports, operation and maintenance information, punch\-list records, and other contractually required documents. + Track punch\-list work and assist the Project Manager and field supervision in achieving timely completion and acceptance. + Confirm that required project documentation has been submitted, approved, and properly retained before final closeout. Safety and Leadership Development * + Perform all responsibilities in accordance with ABI’s safety policies, project\-specific requirements, and applicable laws and regulations. + Promote a proactive, team\-oriented safety culture and immediately communicate observed hazards or concerns to the appropriate project leadership. + Build productive working relationships with field employees and respect the knowledge and experience of ABI’s craft workforce and field leaders. + Take increasing ownership of assigned project responsibilities as knowledge and experience develop. + Continually develop communication, problem\-solving, decision\-making, leadership, and project\-management capabilities. + Pursue relevant continuing education, professional certifications, and advanced degree opportunities, as appropriate to the employee’s career path. + Perform other responsibilities and project\-related assignments as needed. **Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies:** * + Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline preferred. A comparable combination of education and relevant construction experience may be considered. + Prior internship or work experience in concrete construction, heavy civil construction, public works, or infrastructure construction is preferred. + Ability to read and interpret plans, specifications, contracts, geotechnical reports, schedules, shop drawings, and other technical documentation. + Basic understanding of construction methods, quantities, materials, scheduling, and cost management. + Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and project requirements. + Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with field employees, clients, public agencies, engineers, subcontractors, and suppliers. + Demonstrated initiative, dependability, attention to detail, and willingness to accept accountability. + Sound problem\-solving skills and the ability to identify issues, gather relevant information, and help develop practical solutions. + Ability to work effectively in both office and active construction\-site environments. + Proficiency with Microsoft Office and PDF/document\-management software. Experience with Bluebeam, AutoCAD, HCSS, scheduling software, and online plan\-management platforms is preferred. + Ability and willingness to learn ABI’s project\-management, accounting, scheduling, and document\-control systems. + Commitment to ABI’s safety requirements and to maintaining professional and collaborative working relationships. **Certifications:** * + OSHA 30\-Hour Construction certification required or must be obtained within a company\-established timeframe. + First Aid/CPR/AED certification required or must be obtained within a company\-established timeframe. + Valid driver’s license + Ability to travel to ABI project locations throughout New Jersey and the surrounding region, as required. **Work Environment:** This position requires work in both an office environment and active construction sites. The Project Engineer must be able to navigate uneven terrain, stairs, excavations, and other typical jobsite conditions; wear required personal protective equipment; and work outdoors in varying weather conditions. Project demands may occasionally require early mornings, evenings, or other schedule flexibility.

jobs.title: Python Developer (AWS, Serverless)
jobs.description: At Peregrine Advisors, you will develop Python applications on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and take responsibility for the components you deliver. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you taking user stories from refinement through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build serverless, event\-driven application workflows using AWS Lambda and Step Functions. * Integrate commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) products with frameworks developed in\-house. * Build internal and external application programming interface (API) connections. * Build data and document pipelines that automate manual, paper\-based work. You deliver tested, working code you own through production, including the defects you find and fix. You automate business operations that replace manual checks, validations, and spreadsheet workflows, and you build deployment pipelines that make releasing services routine. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of software development experience * Bachelor's degree * Working\-level command of Python * Experience with modern languages and frameworks, and with version control * Familiarity with cloud development on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) concepts * Ability to turn a defined specification into working, tested code and own it through to production * Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Hands\-on delivery of production workloads on Amazon Web Services (AWS), or an AWS certification * Federal information technology experience * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You care about what you build and judge it by whether it works for the people who rely on it. As priorities move, you move with them, and you learn a new tool or domain deeply enough to make judgment calls in it rather than follow instructions. You communicate clearly, adapt across roles and clients, and care about creating public value. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A practical command of modern cloud development, with the range to build something new or make an existing system work better. * The matching delivery habits, meaning version control, unit and integration testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility. * Plain\-language communication about your work with the people who depend on it, explaining clearly and listening for what they need. * The precision to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.* **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

communication skills, especially when working with the public, developers, consultants, or  -- **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** Must be physically able to operate a variety of automated office machines and jobs.title: Senior Research Associate/Associate Scientist, Synthetic Immunology
jobs.description: **Department:** Synthetic Immunology **Reports to:** Sr. Scientist **Location:**Onsite 5 days per week in Berkeley, CA **Employment Type:** Full\-time **FLSA Status:**Exempt **Bonus/Equity:**Eligible ### **About Azalea** Azalea Therapeutics is enabling precision genome engineering directly inside the body, with an initial focus on creating cancer immunotherapies in vivo. Azalea is pioneering a new way to turn a person’s own T cells into a powerful cancer therapy — directly inside the body. Instead of removing cells and manipulating them in a lab, we use precision genome editing tools to engineer T cells where they already live. At the center of our approach are Enveloped Delivery Vehicles, or EDVs. As highly selective couriers, EDVs are designed to specifically locate T cells within the patient and deliver our genome engineering cargo. Once inside the cell, the anti\-cancer agent is inserted into a precise site in the genome, ensuring safe and potent modifications to fortify the T cells against cancers. Why this matters: * We aim to make cell therapy faster and more accessible by avoiding complex manufacturing outside the body. * Our platform is designed for precision, so the right cells are safely programmed to effectively fight cancer. * This technology has the potential to treat a wide range of cancers with a streamlined, scalable process. Our goal is simple: develop next\-generation delivery technologies to bring genetic engineering and cell therapies to more patients. How We Work Azalea is building ambitious science in a fast\-moving environment. The people who thrive here are accountable, adaptable, rigorous, humble, and direct. Across roles and functions, we look for team members who demonstrate the following: * Outcome Ownership \- We own results, close loops, and follow through without needing to be prompted. We take responsibility for moving work forward and making sure important decisions, deliverables, and handoffs do not fall through the cracks. * Comfort with Ambiguity \- We operate in an early\-stage environment where information may be incomplete and priorities may evolve. We clarify quickly, make thoughtful decisions with the information available, and adapt without unnecessary drama. * High Standards, Low Ego \- We care deeply about the quality of the work and the impact it can have for patients. We raise the bar while staying humble, direct, and open to feedback. * Collaboration and Candor \- We share context early, communicate clearly, partner across functions, and operate with transparency. We believe strong collaboration requires both trust and direct communication. ### **The Opportunity** Azalea Therapeutics is seeking a hands\-on, scientifically rigorous Senior Research Associate / Associate Scientist to join our Synthetic Immunology team. In this role, you will help advance next\-generation in vivo cell and gene therapies by generating high\-quality data that supports multiple pre\-clinical programs, functional characterization of engineered immune cells, and broader platform and pipeline development. The successful candidate will bring strong technical judgment and curiosity to complex experimental work. Depending on level, this may include independently planning and executing studies, troubleshooting assays, analyzing and interpreting data, communicating results to project teams, and translating program needs into high\-quality experimental plans. Senior Research Associate candidates will be expected to demonstrate strong technical ownership and reliable independent execution, while Associate Scientist candidates will bring broader experimental design ownership, deeper scientific judgment, and the ability to help shape defined workstreams within program goals. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Independently plan, execute, analyze, and document in vitro experiments to evaluate engineered T cell products, delivery technologies, and functional immune\-cell responses. * Culture, engineer, expand, and characterize primary T cells and relevant mammalian cell lines using viral and non\-viral gene delivery methods. * Perform and optimize cell\-based and immunological assays, including multicolor flow cytometry, FACS\-based workflows, cytokine analysis, proliferation, activation, cytotoxicity, and related functional assays. * Generate high\-quality data to support candidate evaluation, assay development, process and analytical readiness, and decisions about when programs or platform concepts are ready for additional in vivo or translational evaluation. * Troubleshoot experimental workflows, identify sources of variability, recommend assay improvements, and contribute to fit\-for\-purpose method development. * Analyze, interpret, and clearly communicate experimental results, including limitations, risks, follow\-up experiments, and implications for program decisions. * Maintain accurate, timely, and inspection\-ready laboratory records in accordance with Azalea documentation expectations and g combination of education and relevant experience. * Senior Research Associate Required Experience: Minimum 4 years of relevant hands\-on laboratory experience in academic, biotech, or pharmaceutical research. * Associate Scientist Required Experience: Minimum 6 years of relevant hands\-on laboratory experience demonstrating independent experimental design and scientific judgment. * Successful candidates must have hands\-on experience with mammalian cell culture and primary immune cell workflows, including T cell isolation, activation, engineering, expansion, characterization, or related immune cell systems. * Experience with flow cytometry, including multicolor staining, sample preparation, panel execution, data analysis, and interpretation using FlowJo or similar software. * Experience generating, characterizing, or evaluating engineered immune cells, such as CAR T, TCR T, genome\-edited T cells, or related cellular therapy systems. * Demonstrated ability to independently execute experiments, troubleshoot technical issues, analyze and interpret data, maintain accurate records, and communicate findings clearly to scientific teams. * Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, accountability, communication and ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic research environment. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with cytokine quantification methods such as ELISA, MSD, Luminex, or related platforms. * Experience with cytotoxicity assays, Incucyte\-based assays, high\-content imaging, or other quantitative functional readouts. * Experience with viral or non\-viral gene delivery, including lentiviral transduction, AAV\-related workflows, or delivery vehicle characterization. * Experience supporting assay optimization, analytical method development, high\-throughput screening, or comparability\-oriented studies. * Experience working with electronic laboratory notebooks and maintaining high\-quality documentation to support program decisions. * Experience mentoring junior colleagues, training others on laboratory techniques, or coordinating small experimental workstreams. ### **What Success Looks Like in the First 3–6 Months** * Builds fluency in Azalea’s core platform, program priorities, experimental systems, documentation practices, and laboratory workflows. * Independently executes assigned experiments and produces clear, reproducible, well\-documented data that project teams can use with confidence. * Identifies and communicates technical risks, sources of assay variability, and practical recommendations for follow\-up experiments or workflow improvements. * Develop trusted working relationships across research and adjacent functions through clear communication, follow\-through, and thoughtful scientific judgment. * Associate Scientists will begin taking ownership of defined experimental workstreams and meaningfully contribute to study design, data interpretation, and prioritization discussions. ### **Working Conditions / Physical Requirements** * Ability to work onsite at Azalea’s laboratory space in Berkeley, CA five days per week. * Ability to perform laboratory work requiring standing, sitting, pipetting, handling biological samples, using standard laboratory equipment, and following applicable safety procedures. * May require occasional schedule flexibility to support time\-sensitive experiments, cell\-culture workflows, sample processing, or study timelines. ### **Compensation and Benefits** * The expected salary range for this position based in Berkeley, California is $105,000 \- $125,000 per year. Offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience, qualifications, and other job\-related factors permitted by law. Salary will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, training and market. * This role is eligible for annual performance bonuses, equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, retirement plan with company match, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **MintMCP** helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. **AI\-Native Startup** We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team, write code, review PRs, and handle sales, marketing, and deal ops on the same gateway we sell to customers. We are building an entire company operating system around them, and you will help build it. **Traction** Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Stardog Admin

This role is responsible for managing, optimizing, and advancing the organization//'s knowledge graph platform to enable healthcare analytics, interoperability, data governance, semantic integration, and AI\-driven solutions. Administration** * Install, configure, monitor, upgrade, and maintain Stardog environments across development, test, and production environments. * Ensure platform availability, scalability, security, reliability, and performance. * Administer enterprise knowledge graph solutions supporting healthcare analytics, interoperability, benchmarking, quality reporting, and AI initiatives. * Optimize Azure Container Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and related Azure platform services. * Monitor platform health, performance, capacity, and operational metrics. * Support CI/CD processes and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) practices where appropriate. **Required Qualifications** **Education** * Bachelor//'s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Experience** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience administering Stardog or equivalent graph database technologies. * 5\+ years * RDF, OWL, RDFS, SHACL, and semantic web technologies * Knowledge graph architecture and administration * Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning * Identity and access management technologies * Cloud\-based database and application platforms * Performance tuning, monitoring, and capacity management * Linux\-based environments and command\-line administration **Preferred Kubernetes (AKS) **Healthcare Domain Experience** * Healthcare analytics and benchmarking solutions * Population health and value\-based care initiatives * Clinical, operational, quality, payer, or \& Competencies** * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills * Ability to diagnose complex semantic modeling, data integration, and performance issues * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities * Experience working across business, clinical, and technical teams * Ability to translate healthcare business requirements into scalable technical solutions * Self\-starter with strong ownership and accountability * Passion for healthcare analytics, knowledge graphs, semantic technologies, and AI\-enabled decision support

jobs.title: TechOps Engineer
jobs.description: **About Town** -------------- We're an applied AI company building a powerful assistant that makes it easy for anyone to create and use software in their everyday work. Town starts from who you are. It builds a persistent model of you (your voice, judgment, relationships, priorities) and does real work on your behalf across every tool you use: email, calendar, docs, Slack, and CRM. It doesn't wait to be prompted. It observes, learns, and acts. We most recently raised a $55M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Forerunner Ventures and continued support from First Round Capital, Alt Capital, and Conviction, plus angels including Adam D'Angelo, Soleio Cuervo, and Immad Akhund. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring our first TechOps Engineer to keep the technology our team relies on reliable, secure, and easy to use. Reporting to the Head of Engineering, you'll own workplace technology across our San Francisco office, from networks and conference rooms to employee devices, access, and the vendors behind them. This is a hands\-on senior individual contributor role that also owns day\-to\-day execution for our compliance and customer trust programs. You'll run recurring controls, coordinate audits and security reviews, and turn open requests into completed work. You'll partner with engineering, security, and legal on control design, policy, risk decisions, and customer commitments. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Keep the office running.** Own networking, Wi\-Fi, conference rooms, and shared technology. Troubleshoot issues directly and coordinate vendors through resolution. * **Own the employee technology lifecycle.** Manage device procurement, inventory, setup, endpoint management, repairs, and secure offboarding. * **Make access reliable and secure.** Administer Google Workspace, Slack, 1Password, and workplace systems, including provisioning, access changes, reviews, and removal. * **Drive vendors and workplace projects.** Own IT vendor relationships, renewals, and procurement coordination, and deliver the technology portions of office moves and buildouts. * **Run compliance operations.** Operate the SOC 2 calendar and Vanta, collect evidence, coordinate audits, maintain recurring controls and vendor\-risk reviews, and drive remediation to verified completion. * **Support customer trust.** Coordinate security questionnaires and enterprise reviews, keep trust materials and control documentation current, and work with internal owners on accurate answers and commitments. * **Make recurring work easier.** Build clear queues, inventories, and runbooks. Use integrations and automation to reduce manual work and keep priorities, deadlines, and ownership visible. **You might thrive here if you...** ----------------------------------- * **Have experience across technical operations and workplace technology**, with hands\-on responsibility for compliance or GRC execution. * **Know workplace technology firsthand.** You've managed networks, Wi\-Fi, conference rooms, endpoints, identity systems, and SaaS administration, including employee onboarding and offboarding. * **Have supported SOC 2 or continuous compliance.** You've operated controls, collected evidence, worked with auditors, and tracked remediation. * **Can troubleshoot before escalating.** You're comfortable with admin consoles, APIs, logs, device settings, and network tooling. * **Write clearly and work well across teams.** You can explain technical issues and compliance evidence to employees, engineers, auditors, customers, and vendors. * **Take ownership and follow through.** You prioritize independently, document decisions, verify outcomes, and use sound judgment about when to involve security, legal, or other decision\-makers. * **Enjoy hands\-on work with people.** You're willing to tackle the detailed work that keeps a team running and get energy from working together in person five days a week. **Location** ------------ In person in San Francisco's Financial District, five days a week. Everyone is here to do their best work and make this product a success. Compensation Range: $175K \- $200K

Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

experience measures; and helping partners improve the end\-to\-end customer journey. **What You'll Do** * Analyze customer and operational trends, patterns, and key drivers to identify meaningful insights, emerging experience issues, and opportunities to improve the end\-to\-end customer journey and business performance. * Translate quantitative and qualitative findings into clear, actionable interaction channels. * Analyze customer feedback from surveys, contact\-center interactions, complaints, reviews, social channels, and other Voice of Customer sources. functions. * Strong proficiency in **Excel, Snowflake, and Sigma** with experience working with large datasets. * Strong **SQL** skills and experience querying, analyzing, and validating data within **Snowflake** or a comparable cloud data warehouse. * Working knowledge of **SQL** also with **SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)** preferably with Microsoft Dataverse. * Experience with one or more analytical or programming to l storytelling skills, with the ability to make insights clear and persuasive for executive and non\-technical audiences. * Experience identifying themes and patterns in unstructured data such as customer comments, call notes, case narratives, reviews, or transcripts. * Ability to combine quantitative analysis with qualitative interpretation to explain not only what customers are experiencing, but why. * Experience with text analytics, sentiment analysis, natural\-language processing, speech analytics, or AI\-assisted insight tools. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working with Customer Care metrics such as **service level, response time, handle time, customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, contact volume, and related operational KPIs**. * Experience with data documentation. * Familiarity with data quality methodologies and root\-cause analysis. * Advanced proficiency with **Excel, Snowflake, and Sigma** with experience working with large datasets. * Experience supporting the transition from legacy or manually maintained reporting to modern self\-service analytics solutions. * Knowledge of sampling, confidence intervals, jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with Adobe's Experience Intelligence team, you will compose, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems. These systems power intelligent experiences across commercial and promotional activities. You will work on GenAI agents, predictive ML, retrieval and reasoning systems, and the platforms that support them at scale. Partnering with engineers, product managers, and business collaborators, you will turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable, scalable solutions that solve real\-world business problems. **Key Responsibilities:** Design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems, including GenAI agents, predictive ML, retrieval and reasoning systems, agent frameworks, tool calling, multi\-agent workflows, APIs, and data pipelines, with a strong focus on quality, scalability, reliability, and performance. Develop AI/ML solutions over large\-scale structured and unstructured enterprise data, including evaluation frameworks and techniques to continuously improve accuracy and user experience. Own solutions end\-to\-end, from architecture and experimentation through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Partner closely with product managers and collaborators to identify high\-value problems and integrate AI capabilities into real\-world sales and marketing workflows. Identify and prototype emerging AI opportunities, turning new technologies and ideas into differentiated, production\-ready capabilities. **What You Need to Succeed:** MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5\+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning, GenAI, NLP, retrieval, or related AI systems. Strong understanding of modern LLM and agentic AI technologies, including RAG, tool/function calling, reasoning, evaluation, and context management. Strong foundation in machine learning, predictive modeling, statistics, and techniques for working with large\-scale structured and unstructured data. Strong software engineering skills, including Python, data structures and algorithms, system design, testing, code quality, and production debugging. Experience building production AI/ML services using technologies such as PyTorch, REST APIs, Docker, data/orchestration pipelines, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. Experience designing scalable and reliable AI systems and evaluating them across quality, latency, cost, and operational performance. Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams in a fast\-paced environment. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Aeroflow Health – Data Engineer** Aeroflow Health is a national leader in home medical equipment and clinical services. We combine technology, operational excellence, and compassionate expertise to deliver essential products and care directly to patients’ homes. At Aeroflow Health, we make healthcare accessible by taking a holistic approach to how we care for our patients. We are equally passionate about taking care of our employees. Recognized as one of the fastest\-growing healthcare companies in the U.S., an Inc. 5000 honoree, and a certified Great Place to Work®, Aeroflow continues to seek ways to be one of the nation’s top employers. As we continue to grow, we remain committed to building an exceptional workplace where talented professionals are empowered, supported, and inspired to make a meaningful impact every day. **The Opportunity** Within Aeroflow, the **SQL Engineering team** builds and supports the databases, data pipelines, and application logic that power critical operational workflows across the organization. Our environment combines deeply established Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) systems with a growing AWS cloud ecosystem. As Aeroflow continues to scale, the team is focused not only on supporting today’s environment, but also on thoughtfully modernizing how our data systems are built, deployed, and maintained for the future. We are looking for a hands\-on **Data Engineer** who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, writing and optimizing production SQL, improving existing systems, and partnering directly with both technical teams and business stakeholders. This is an **engineering\-focused position rather than a reporting, BI, or analytics\-focused role**. While every week will look a little different, you can expect the role to be approximately **60% hands\-on SQL/AWS engineering, 20% business and technical partnership, and 20% code review and engineering collaboration.** This position works on a **hybrid schedule, three days per week in the office.** **Your Primary Responsibilities:** **Hands\-on Data \& SQL Engineering:** * Design, develop, and maintain reliable SQL\-based solutions that support critical operational and application workflows. * Write and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, data models, and production database logic. * Troubleshoot, optimize, and refactor existing SQL code and legacy processes to improve performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and workflows across established database systems and modern AWS environments. * Navigate complex integrations and data dependencies across multiple systems and business functions. * Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, automate manual processes, and thoughtfully modernize legacy solutions. **Business \& Technical Partnership** * Partner directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand the problem behind the request—not simply execute against a ticket. * Translate business requirements into practical, maintainable engineering solutions. * Ask thoughtful questions, uncover dependencies and constraints, and help stakeholders understand technical tradeoffs. * Collaborate closely with Application Engineering, Analytics, and other technology teams to deliver solutions that work effectively across systems and business functions. **Engineering Quality \& Team Contribution** * Review code and collaborate with other engineers to improve quality, consistency, performance, and maintainability. * Apply sound technical judgment when balancing scalability, reliability, complexity, performance, and business needs. * Develop and maintain clear technical documentation for database architecture, workflows, and engineering processes. * Contribute as a hands\-on individual engineer while sharing knowledge and helping strengthen engineering practices across the team. * Maintain HIPAA/patient confidentiality and comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies. * Compliance is a condition of employment and is considered an element of job performance. * Maintain regular and reliable attendance as assigned by your schedule. * Perform other job duties as assigned. **Skills for Success** * **Strong SQL engineering instincts:** Understand how database design, query structure, indexing, and application behavior affect performance and reliability. * **Analytical problem\-solving:** Enjoy digging into complicated problems, tracing dependencies, identifying root causes, and improving systems rather than simply treating symptoms. * **Pragmatic technical judgment:** Distinguish meaningful engineering improvements from unnecessary complexity and clearly explain the tradeoffs behind your recommendations. * **Systems thinking:** Understand how databases, applications, infrastructure, integrations, and business processes interact rather than viewing SQL in isolation. * **Business curiosity:** Ask questions, understand the underlying business problem, and he ipating in or leading a migration from a legacy database or technology stack to a modern architecture or cloud environment. * Deeper hands\-on experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS, Glue, Athena, or related technologies. * Experience with Python, Bash, or another scripting language used for automation or data engineering. * Experience with orchestration or transformation tools such as Apache Airflow or dbt. * Experience with source control, automated testing, or CI/CD practices for database and data engineering changes. * Experience supporting mission\-critical, healthcare, or other regulated production environments requiring strong availability, security, disaster recovery, or audit discipline. **What We Look For** We are looking for highly motivated, talented engineers who measure success by the reliability of the systems they build and the business problems they help solve. You should: * Be naturally curious and willing to dig beneath the initial request to understand the real problem that needs to be solved. * Take ownership of your work and be comfortable operating with autonomy while knowing when to collaborate or ask for input. * Care about writing maintainable, reliable, and testable code—not simply getting something to work. * Enjoy improving existing systems and processes rather than requiring a perfect greenfield environment. * Bring a practical, thoughtful approach to modernization and recognize when newer technology adds meaningful value. * Be comfortable working directly with stakeholders and asking questions rather than relying exclusively on tickets or predefined requirements. * Be collaborative, coachable, and willing to both give and receive thoughtful technical feedback. * Leave systems, processes, and teams stronger than you found them. **What Aeroflow Offers** **What Aeroflow Offers** Competitive Pay, Health Plans with FSA or HSA options, Dental, and Vision Insurance, Optional Life Insurance, 401K with Company Match, 12 weeks of parental leave for birthing parent/ 4 weeks leave for non\-birthing parent(s), Additional Parental benefits to include fertility stipends, free diapers, breast pump, Paid Holidays, PTO Accrual from day one, Employee Assistance Programs and SO MUCH MORE!! Here at Aeroflow, we are proud of our commitment to all of our employees. Aeroflow Health has been recognized both locally and nationally for the following achievements: * **Family Forward Certified** * **Great Place to Work Certified** * **Inc. 5000 Best Place to Work award winner** * **HME Excellence Award** * **Sky High Growth Award** If you’ve been looking for an opportunity that will allow you to make an impact, and an organization with unlimited growth potential, we want to hear from you! Aeroflow Health is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Agile Defense** At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next. Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests. **Requisition \#:** 1853 **Job Title:** Network Security Engineer **Location:** Suitland, MD **Clearance Level:** Public Trust ### **Job Description** Agile Defense is seeking a Senior Network Security Engineer to support the agency as it moves away from its legacy ForeScout CounterACT NAC/NAM system and adopts Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) as the new access control platform. The engineer will help configure and manage Cisco ISE across the environment, handling AAA services, wired and wireless 802\.1X authentication, device administration, and posture checks for users and devices. This role also supports the agency’s modernization work by improving authentication processes, updating ISE policies, and strengthening identity\-based access controls. The engineer will troubleshoot access issues, refine policy designs, and help ensure users and devices can connect securely and reliably as the organization completes its transition from ForeScout to Cisco ISE. * Troubleshoot and resolve Cisco ISE issues across RADIUS, TACACS\+, 802\.1X, device administration, and endpoint authentication. * Deploy, configure, and maintain Cisco ISE running on two clustered Cisco SNS 3715 appliances, ensuring high availability and consistent policy enforcement. * Support the agency’s migration from ForeScout CounterACT to Cisco ISE, including reviewing legacy ForeScout policies, device groups, and access rules and mapping them into ISE policy sets. * Provide general wireless support, including basic troubleshooting, wireless access workflows, and coordination with wireless infrastructure teams. * Configure and support Cisco ISE integrations with Cisco 9800 WLCs, including guest/registration portals, wireless onboarding, and policy driven access control. * Integrate and maintain Cisco ISE with Active Directory (AD) and LDAP, including identity lookups, group based authorization, and directory based authentication workflows. * Deploy, configure, and maintain Cisco ISE components, including: o Policy Sets, Authorization Profiles, and Authentication Rules o TACACS\+ device administration o 802\.1X for wired and wireless networks o Profiling, posture, and compliance policies o Certificate based authentication and PKI integrations * Monitor security events using ISE logs, syslog, and performing root cause analysis for authentication and access issues. * Manage identity integrations, enforce security policies, and tune configurations to support Zero Trust and improve user experience. * Perform routine health checks, upgrades, migrations, and document changes through SOPs, engineering designs, and implementation procedures. * Work closely with engineering, operations, and compliance teams while mentoring junior staff and contributing to knowledge sharing efforts. ### **Education and Background** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field. ### **Years of Experience** * Eight (8\) years of experience in a large government organization with five (5\) years in technical leadership, including four (4\) years implementing and troubleshooting Cisco ISE. * Four (4\) years of experience supporting identity centric or Zero Trust architectures with strong knowledge of segmentation, certificate management, and endpoint posture controls. ### **Required Skills** Senior Network Security Engineer responsible for designing, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting Cisco ISE as a NAC/NAM platform, including TACACS\+/RADIUS services, device administration policies, and wired/wireless 802\.1X authentication. * Eight (8\) years of experience in a large government organization with five (5\) years in technical leadership, including four (4\) years implementing and troubleshooting Cisco ISE with expertise in: o Authentication and authorization policies (RADIUS/TACACS\+) o 802\.1X/EAP methods for wireless and wired access o Device profiling, posture checks, and endpoint compliance o Certificate based authentication (EAP TLS) and PKI integration o AAA integrations for switches, appliances, firewalls, and wireless controllers * Experience working with Cisco ISE deployed on Cisco SNS 3715 appliances, preferably in a two node clustered, high availability setup. * Understanding of ForeScout CounterACT, including legacy NAC/NAM policies, device classification, and access workflows, to support the migration to Cisco ISE * Experience providing general wireless network support, including basic troubleshooting, controller interactions, and wireless access workflows. * Hands on experience integrating Cisco ISE with Active Directory (AD) and LDAP, including identity lookups, group based policy decisions, and directory based authentication. * Experience supporting Cisco ISE integrations with Cisco 9800 Wireless LAN Controllers, including guest/registration page redirection and wireless onboarding. * Experience migrating legacy NAC, RADIUS, or device authentication systems into Cisco ISE while aligning with Zero Trust principles. * Solid understanding of telecommunications, network security, and Zero Trust best practices. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain Cisco ISE, NAC/NAM, and AAA concepts to both technical and non technical audiences. ### **Preferred Skills** * Preferred certifications: Cisco CCNP Security, Cisco ISE Specialist, or similar identity/security certifications. ### **Working Conditions** * On\-site 5 days a week in Suitland, Maryland In addition, Agile Defense invests in its employees beyond just compensation. Agile’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short\-term and long\-term Disability, Retirement and Learning and Development opportunities as well as other optional benefit elections. **Our Core Values** Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together. What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are. * **Happy** \- Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do. * **Helpful** \- Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated. * **Honest** \- Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support. * **Humble** \- Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task. * **Hungry** \- Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges. * **Hustle** \- Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success. **Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information.
