jobs.title: Environmental Compliance Inspector
jobs.description: **Position Description** ------------------------ Seattle Public Utilities (SPU) is looking for a motivated, detail\-driven **Environmental Compliance Inspector**, under the city of Seattle job classification of (**Civil Engineer, Specialist Associate**), to join our team and help safeguard Seattle’s communities and environment. In this role, you’ll make a real impact by protecting our wastewater infrastructure, supporting sustainable practices, and helping local businesses and residents understand how they can contribute to a cleaner, healthier city. In this role, you will use your engineering mindset to: * Assess and enforce compliance with the City’s Fats, Oils, and Grease (FOG) program to protect pipe integrity and prevent system failures. * Investigate sewer\-related issues, applying problem\-solving and analytical skills to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions. * Conduct outreach to businesses and residents, helping them understand how small changes can prevent costly infrastructure damage. * Respond to environmental incidents to safeguard public health and minimize impacts on wastewater and stormwater systems. **About Seattle Public Utilities:** Seattle Public Utilities (SPU) is a community\-centered utility that delivers vital services to Seattle residents and businesses including drinking water, drainage and wastewater, and garbage/recycling/compost. SPU also provides drinking water for 1\.5 million customers in the region. SPU’s work includes system maintenance and improvements and keeping Seattle clean. Over 1,400 SPU employees work with our community to provide affordable and equitable stewardship of our water and waste resources for future generations. **For more information about Seattle Public Utilities (SPU), check out the:** * SPU Website * SPU Workplace Expectations (Download PDF reader)(Download PDF reader) * Strategic Business Plan SPU commits to Our City Values and Race and Social Justice as core principles that guide our work. We actively take steps to dismantle systemic racism and increase service equity. We value diverse life experiences and strive to create a workplace that is welcoming to all. We take steps to be inclusive and equitable in our recruiting, hiring and promotional opportunities. **Why join us?** We know work isn't only about what you do it’s also about who you work for and with! SPU provides a fun and family\-friendly work environment that supports a work life balance, including: * Hybrid work schedule opportunities * Family\-friendly and multicultural work environment * Generous benefits package * Free Orca Pass * City pension plan with employer/employee contributions * Growth potential and advancement opportunities **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ * + Assist with collecting, organizing, and interpreting GIS data, inspection results, and other program data sets to support program monitoring, metric tracking, and reporting. * Assist with the managing and maintenance of program databases, including routine data entry, data quality checks, and generating summary reports. Provide basic technical troubleshooting for Microsoft Office, mobile inspection tools, and related software used by the program. * Conduct site visits/inspections of food service establishments to ensure compliance with city codes associated with the Fats, Oils, and Grease (FOG) program and educate facilities on these requirements and best management practices. * Prepare enforcement letters, assess penalties, and track corrective actions associated with non\-compliant wastewater discharges. jobs.title: Stormwater Management Coordinator
jobs.description: **Position Overview** --------------------- The City of Wilsonville is seeking a **Stormwater Management Coordinator** to oversee and coordinate the City's stormwater management program. This position plays a key role in administering stormwater permits, conducting inspections, supporting development review, coordinating water quality monitoring, and ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal stormwater regulations. We're looking for a collaborative and organized professional who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and managing multiple projects. You'll work closely with City staff, regulatory agencies, businesses with private stormwater facilities, and community members to support compliance efforts, inspections, water quality monitoring, permit requirements, and other stormwater program activities. **Why Join Wilsonville?*** Lead and coordinate a comprehensive municipal stormwater program * Work on a variety of technical, field, and regulatory projects * Collaborate with a dedicated team of public servants * Serve a growing and innovative community **Open until filled. First review of applications will occur two weeks after the posting date. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply early for best consideration.** Learn more and apply today! Additional information regarding this position, including minimum qualifications and essential job functions, can be found below. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ The Stormwater Management Coordinator coordinates and implements the City's Stormwater Management, and Environmental Compliance Programs. Responsibilities include administration of the City's Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4\) Permit, Stormwater Management Plan (SWMP), Total Maximum Daily Load (TMDL) requirements, stormwater facility compliance programs, water quality monitoring, construction stormwater permitting activities, environmental inspections, development review, public outreach, and regulatory reporting. The position serves as a technical resource and subject matter expert regarding stormwater management, environmental protection, water quality, and associated federal, state, and local regulations. The Stormwater Management Coordinator reports directly to the City Engineer. Supervision or budget administration is not normally a function of this position, but the employee may occasionally act as a lead worker on projects. This is a journey\-level, specialized class that independently performs a wide variety of environmental compliance duties, including field inspections, project implementation, public outreach, and preparing and filing reports with the appropriate regulatory agencies. Responsibilities include performing diverse, specialized, and complex work involving significant accountability and decision\-making responsibility. The incumbent organizes and oversees day\-to\-day activities of the City's stormwater management program. Successful performance of the work requires skill in coordinating programmatic activities and department work. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **ESSENTIAL** **RESPONSIBILITIES***The following tasks are representative and not to be considered all inclusive.* * Develops and implements short\- and long\-range goals and objectives related to stormwater management, environmental compliance, and water quality protection activities; evaluates program effectiveness and recommends modifications. * Participates in implementation and compliance activities associated with the City's National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4\) Permit, Stormwater Management Plan, Total Maximum Daily Load (TMDL) requirements, and related environmental compliance programs. * Reviews and evaluates regulatory documents, reports and proposals relating to areas of environmental or natural resource science. * Participates in projects using natural systems management techniques to enhance, restore or conserve natural resources, including wetlands, uplands, stream riparian corridors, and other habitats. * Provide overall coordination and compliance with the City's NPDES Stormwater permit and implementation of the Stormwater Management Plan. * Administer Oregon Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) 1200\-CN construction stormwater permit responsibilities within the City's Qualified Local Program, including review of eligible construction activities, erosion and sediment control measures, permit compliance requirements, inspections, and documentation. * Coordinate activities associated with DEQ 1200\-CA permits and other applicable construction stormwater permit programs for public infrastructure projects. * Coordinate compliance activities associated with stormwater management and environmental protection requirements. Responsible for identifying required activities and results, coordinating w ers, and the general public. * Ability to comprehend and make inferences from written material. * Ability to read and understand construction documents, details, schematics, layouts, and other visual aids. * Ability to analyze and evaluate work programs and make corrections when necessary. * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with City management, coworkers, supervisors, contractors, property owners, other agencies, and the general public. * Strong organizational and interpersonal skills. * Ability to evaluate alternatives and make sound, creative recommendations and present recommendations to individuals from all levels of the City, as well as individuals outside the City. * Ability to analyze data and prepare reports and utilize a computer to track program costs and results. * Ability to make decisions independently in accordance with established policies and to use good judgment in carrying out tasks and responsibilities with little supervision or guidance. * Ability to operate computers using spreadsheets, databases, and word processing applications at an intermediate to advanced level. * Ability to compile and maintain comprehensive and detailed records systems. * Ability to coordinate and implement program requirements. * Ability to comply with safety requirements of the position and actively promote safe work practices. * Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers, management, elected officials and the general public, and display excellent interpersonal skills and awareness of controversial and/or sensitive issues. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Working Environment:** Work is performed both in the office and in the field. Duties will occasionally involve working in adverse or inclement weather conditions; exposure to high noise levels; dealing with distraught or difficult individuals; attending meetings or activities outside normal working hours; occasional response to emergency conditions during office hours; and operation of a motor vehicle on public roads. **Physical Requirements:** Must possess mobility to work in a standard office setting and use standard office equipment, including a computer; to work in the field; strength, stamina, and mobility to perform light to medium physical work, to work in confined spaces, around machines, and to climb and descend ladders; vision to read printed materials and a computer screen; and hearing and speech to communicate in person and over the telephone or radio. The job involves fieldwork requiring frequent walking in operational areas, including rough and uneven terrain, to identify problems or hazards. Finger dexterity is needed to access, enter, and retrieve data using a computer keyboard or calculator and to operate above\-mentioned tools and equipment. Positions in this classification bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and climb to perform work and inspect work sites. Employees must possess the ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and objects weighing up to 50 pounds and heavier weights with the use of proper equipment. **Cognitive Functions:** The position incumbent works in a fast\-paced environment characterized by frequent deadlines, interruptions, and decision making processes. Work is performed with minimal direction and supervision. In the course of conducting these duties, the Stormwater Management Coordinator independently evaluates and applies environmental regulations, permit requirements, and technical standards. Complex regulatory interpretations, policy issues, and significant enforcement matters may require consultation and approval by management.. The incumbent must be capable of working effectively with coworkers and members of the public. Concentration and focus are required to complete complex, detail oriented tasks. **Equipment used:** Personal computer with application software. Camera, hand tools, absorbent booms, portable samplers, flow meters, measuring devices, and utility vehicle.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- General \& AdministrativeIT **We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.** ------------------------------------------------------------------- We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real\-world tasks, apply to join us. We’re looking for an IT Support Engineer to own frontline employee support in our San Francisco office and raise the quality of service across Cognition’s global IT operations. This role is for someone who views support as a technical and service discipline, not simply a stepping stone. The right person can manage volume without sacrificing care, remain calm when the environment is changing quickly, and turn incomplete reports into clear diagnoses and durable resolutions. Engineering depth may vary, but strong candidates see frontline support as a craft in its own right, are building depth in one or two adjacent areas, and can partner closely with global IT engineers to turn recurring employee friction into scalable solutions. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. Leadership comes through service judgment, standards, coaching, and problem ownership rather than people management. This role is onsite five days a week in San Francisco. We value teamwork and in\-person collaboration. **What you’ll do** ------------------ ### **Deliver support employees trust** * Serve as a primary IT partner for employees across walk\-ups, chat, tickets, and other support channels, owning issues through resolution while delivering a consistent and thoughtful experience. * Ask effective clarifying questions, reproduce issues, test assumptions, and troubleshoot from first principles rather than relying on scripted fixes alone. * Balance a high\-volume queue with walk\-ups and high\-touch support, prioritizing work by urgency, impact, and service commitments. * Communicate with clarity and empathy, setting expectations and providing useful updates even when resolution requires another team or vendor. ### **Operate a disciplined support service** * Maintain strong issue hygiene across categorization, ownership, documentation, follow\-up, SLA performance, escalation, and closure quality. * Create evidence\-rich escalations with reproducible steps, actions taken, relevant logs, expected behavior, and business impact. * Use support data and employee feedback to identify recurring issues, service gaps, and opportunities to improve response quality and visibility. * Support reliable employee lifecycle and workplace operations across endpoints, identity, SaaS, conferencing, hardware, and software assets in partnership with global system owners. ### **Improve and scale how support works** * Turn recurring issues into clear runbooks, knowledge\-base content, self\-service guidance, reusable troubleshooting patterns, and structured context that helps Console.ai and Devin deliver better support. * Configure and continuously improve Console.ai using real support patterns, including knowledge, skills, intake questions, response quality, and escalation paths. * Translate recurring employee friction into clear requirements and work closely with global IT engineers and IT leadership through solution design, testing, rollout, and measurement of service desk KPIs and outcomes. * Improve repeated workflows through service configuration, reporting, and automation, building directly where appropriate and partnering with engineers when deeper technical implementation is required. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * A track record of remaining hands\-on in frontline enterprise support while raising standards for issue quality, troubleshooting, and employee experience. * Demonstrated experience operating in high\-volume support environments that combine queue\-based service with walk\-ups and workplace technology support. * A developed point of view on support quality, prioritization, escalation, and where documentation, self\-service, or automation will improve the employee experience. * Strong troubleshooting experience across macOS and Windows endpoints, mobile devices, identity and access, SaaS applications, conferencing, and network connectivity. * Experience working within an ITSM queue and maintaining high standards for ticket ownership, categorization, SLA performance, documentation, escalation, and follow\-through. * A track record of resolving ambiguous or complex issues by asking good questions, gathering evidence, isolating variables, and communicating a clear path forward. * Experience supporting identity and workplace platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, VPN, and MDM\-managed devices. * Evidence of improving support through better documentation, service data, quality testing, workflow automation, or process design. * Strong written and verbal communication with the judgment to adapt to employees, executives, technical partners, and vendors. * Ability to work onsite five days a week in San Francisco. **An ideal candidate will bring** --------------------------------- * **Service mindset:** Treats each interaction as an opportunity to build trust and provides thoughtful support even under pressure. * **Composure:** Remains calm, organized, and clear during high volume, rapid change, and high\-impact issues. * **Ownership:** Follows problems through resolution or evidence\-rich escalation and keeps employees informed along the way. * **Curiosity:** Investigates how systems work, challenges assumptions, and looks for opportunities to develop deeper technical expertise. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience in a high\-touch, customer\-facing technical support or hardware repair environment. * Experience providing onsite support to executives or other high\-impact employee groups. * Experience using SQL, reporting, or service analytics to identify trends and improve operations. * Experience automating support or access workflows with scripts, APIs, or low\-code tools. * Experience leading UAT, service migrations, taxonomy improvements, or support\-quality initiatives. * Deeper experience in IAM, MDM, endpoint engineering, or AI\-enabled ITSM. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. alerting, and analytics, with a track record of using operational data to improve reliability or customer experience. * Experience automating network operations with a modern programming or scripting language and applying APIs, infrastructure\-as\-code, Git, or CI/CD to configuration delivery. * Working knowledge of network security and identity controls, including IEEE 802\.1X, NAC, AAA, RBAC, segmentation, IDS/IPS, or related technologies. * Experience coordinating carriers, contractors, and vendors while maintaining clear internal ownership of architecture, quality, documentation, and outcomes. * Strong judgment, communication, and service orientation, with a track record of carrying ambiguous problems through design, implementation, and ongoing operation. **An ideal candidate will bring** ================================= * Ownership: Treats reliability and customer experience as personal responsibilities, drives ambiguous work through completion, and remains accountable across This role combines advanced test automation, API validation, cloud testing, and emerging AI technologies to ensure the delivery of reliable, scalable, and high\-performing solutions. Work Model We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. jobs.title: Sr Full Stack Engineer, Platform Services
jobs.description: **Senior** **Full Stack** **Engineer, Platform Services** **College Board****–**Technology, InfoSec \& Infrastructure **Location:**This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes. **Type:** This is a full\-time position **About the Team** The Platform Services Team helps monitor and assure the health, security, and performance of the systems within a shared platform. The team owns a key piece of the platform shell, a shared foundation that domain teams across the organization build on to deliver a unified user experience. Team is responsible for designing, building, and deploying into the shell, integrating data and functionality from multiple domains into a single, cohesive entry point for users. It's a high\-visibility role at the intersection of architecture, cross\-domain collaboration, and platform reliability. **About****the Opportunity** As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will play a strong technical role in the design, development, and reliability of a cloud\-native, AWS\-based platform that aggregates data and services from multiple domains into a cohesive, performant, and role\-aware user experience for teachers, students, and administrators. You bring strong full\-stack engineering experience, with deep hands\-on skills across React front\-end development and AWS\-based backend/API architecture. You are comfortable owning solutions end\-to\-end — from API design and cloud infrastructure to secure service layers and polished, responsive UI components — and you can guide architectural decisions, not just implement them. You are experienced in building Backend for Frontend (BFF) patterns that aggregate multi\-domain APIs into clean, efficient contracts tailored to the UI's needs. You have a strong grasp of authentication and session\-aware UI — designing and implementing role\-based rendering, token handling, and post\-login experiences that adapt to the user's profile and permissions. You understand the performance demands of a landing page — applying strategies such as lazy loading, caching, and web vitals optimization to ensure fast, reliable experiences across devices. You are senior enough to mentor other engineers, drive technical design discussions, and push back constructively on approaches that won't scale, while remaining hands\-on in the code. You understand cloud software delivery practices deeply and are technologically curious, staying current on emerging tools, patterns, and standards. Your communication and collaboration skills allow you to articulate solutions clearly to both engineers and stakeholders while maintaining a clear, unified experience for the end user. *In this role, you will:* Software Solutioning \& Design (10%) * Develop deep understanding of the business processes and domains that the BAWP UI serves * Lead evaluation of feature requests, provide effort estimates, and drive sprint/technical planning * Define and own architectural patterns and API contracts for integrating multiple domain services into the BAWP UI * Lead peer code and design reviews to ensure quality, consistency, and scalability Design, Architecture \& Implementation (60%) * Architect and build scalable, secure full\-stack solutions using React (TypeScript) on the front end and AWS\-native services on the backend * Design and implement APIs and data integration layers that aggregate content from multiple upstream domains, with robust handling of latency, partial failures, and caching * Build reusable, well\-architected front\-end components and shared modules within the BAWP Shell (micro\-frontend/Module Federation or equivalent) * Design and implement cloud\-native architectures using AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, ECS, CloudWatch) * Apply and evolve architectural patterns, automation practices, and observability standards across the platform * Ensure systems meet enterprise requirements for scalability, data integrity, security, availability, and reliability * Integrate monitoring, telemetry, and operational readiness into all platform components * Own and evolve automated end\-to\-end and UI testing frameworks (Playwright) to ensure application quality and reliability * Drive performance optimization across API integration and rendering layers Technical Contribution \& Engineering Excellence (20%) * Solve complex technical problems and drive improvements to overall system design * Mentor and guide other engineers on best practices in development, testing, and system design * Continuously evaluate and introduce new cloud, front\-end, and test automation technologies where they add value * Communicate technical approaches, tradeoffs, and architectural decisions clearly to engineering and business stakeholders * Champion best practices in secure system design, automation,   with AWS services: Lambda, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, S3, Step Functions, EC2, ECS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, DynamoDB * Experience with Backstage and GitHub Actions * Experience designing systems that integrate and aggregate data and content from multiple independent backend/domain services into a single UI * Strong knowledge of distributed cloud infrastructure and microservices architecture * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation) * Experience building responsive, secure, high\-performance UIs using React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS * Familiarity with micro\-frontend architectures (e.g., Module Federation) and shared shell/component patterns * Experience with automated testing frameworks, for end\-to\-end and UI testing, and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines * Strong focus on scalability, data integrity, reliability, and quality engineering practices * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present ideas in business\-friendly language and mentor other engineers * Ability to prioritize and lead execution of tasks in a high\-pressure, fast\-paced environment Nice to Have: * Experience with monitoring/observability tools such as Grafana, CloudWatch dashboards * Familiarity with real\-time stream processing (Apache Flink or similar) * Familiarity with ML/AI lifecycle concepts, and interest in AI\-driven features (e.g., AI\-generated insights) as part of the platform roadmap * Understanding of data isolation, performance segmentation, and secure access in distributed systems **All roles at College Board require:** * **A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities** and mission\-driven work * Authorization to work in the United States for any employer * **Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies**, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI\-driven solutions and a comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. * **Clear and concise communication skills**, written and verbal * **A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth:**welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input. * **A drive for impact and excellence:**solving complex problems, making data\-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking. * **A collaborative and empathetic approach:**working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success. **About Our Process** * Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. * While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks. **What We Offer** At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self\-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market. *A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation* * The hiring range for this role is $153,000–$166,000\. * Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board. * We aim to make our best offer upfront rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data. * We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live. You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at the College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more. \#LI\-EA1 \#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.title: Regional Discipline Leader - Bridges & Structures
jobs.description: Colliers Engineering \& Design is seeking a Regional Discipline Leader to lead our Bridges \& Structures team in Florida! The Regional Discipline Leader is responsible for the professional, technical, management, marketing, administrative and financial aspects of the Bridge \& Structures Discipline in a specific region. Join our Bridges \& Structures team and advance your career alongside some of the industry’s most respected engineers! Our bridge professionals play a vital role in keeping the nation’s infrastructure safe, resilient, and moving forward. Our engineers gain hands\-on experience across a diverse range of bridge types and project scales. Our team values smart, innovative solutions that balance technical excellence with real\-world cost and schedule considerations. If you’re looking for meaningful work, professional growth, and the chance to work with other experienced leaders, you’ll find it with us. * Provides leadership, managerial direction and guidance for the region to achieve established goals. * Directs overall productivity, profitability, client satisfaction and quality of work. * Responsible for discipline marketing and business development. * Actively involved in the cross selling of all company services. * Responsible for billings and collections. * Works with the geographic discipline leaders on resource sharing and staffing needs. * Responsible for regional training and staff development. * Monitor staff utilization regularly and take corrective action if necessary. * Complies and ensures others compliance with all CED policies and procedures, including but not limited to the Health and Safety Program. * Travel regularly to the various regions and offices. * Bachelor's degree in civil engineering required. * 15\+ years of progressive leadership and managerial experience in the civil engineering industry with 10\+ years of bridge engineering experience required. * PE (professional engineer) license required. * Prior DOT experience is highly preferred. * Demonstrated effective leadership across large groups of employees. * Excellent communication skills. * Ability to read, write, and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job\-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

jobs.title: Billing Analyst

jobs.title: Drainage Design Engineer
jobs.description: *What Your Day Will Look Like:* : As a Drainage Design Engineer, you will apply hydrologic and hydraulic engineering principles to the planning, analysis, and design of drainage infrastructure for transportation and roadway improvement projects. Working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and under the guidance of senior engineers, you will contribute to the development of innovative and cost\-effective stormwater management solutions, including storm sewer systems, culverts, open channels, detention and retention facilities, roadway drainage networks, and hydraulic structures. In this role, you will perform drainage analyses, prepare engineering calculations, develop construction plans and technical reports, and support the evaluation of flood risks, watershed impacts, and regulatory compliance requirements. You will utilize industry\-standard design software and modeling tools to assess system performance and ensure designs meet applicable federal, state, and local transportation agency standards, drainage criteria, and environmental regulations. As your experience grows, you will take increasing ownership of project deliverables, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, assist in resolving complex engineering challenges, and contribute to project planning and execution efforts. jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer, Hardware Development
jobs.description: **About Us** We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! If you are an experienced Electrical Engineer, Copeland has an exciting opportunity for you! As a Lead Electrical Engineer on our Oil Free Centrifugal team, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and supporting the electrical component, hardware development and additionally work with the lab team providing support and training. Based in our Sidney, OH location, you will be a team member on the Oil\-Free Centrifugal team. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious, process\-oriented person. **As a Centrifugal Electrical Engineer, you will:** * Work closely with the Controls Engineering team to learn and understand the control method and develop the process for validating electrical hardware. * Follow the requirements of Copeland Business System * Work together to optimize the design, program logic, testing methods of the controller, control program, VFD, motor, cabling, transformer and supervisory control system. * Explore the opportunity for ancillary equipment (remote data communication and storage, control program updates, 120V power supply transformer, HVAC, Hydraulic Control Center (HCC), etc.) * Own and optimize the design, performance and durability of the electrical systems * Work with the design team to maintain BOM and electrical drawing packages for OFC, Compressors’ electrical components \& systems * Review and evaluate existing system against customer requirements * Support the team in development efforts for new products or improvements to existing products * Work with experts to validate the electrical system design for present and future products * Interpret and draw conclusions from test data obtained during validation activities * Train and support production and field teams on product assembly and connection processes * Document electrical system configuration and user guides and procedures * Develop and document test set ups and procedures * Work with supplier to optimize power electronics and motor designs * Develop and champion electrical safety best practices for the company * Lead troubleshooting efforts on OFC compressor controller, drive and motor * Field service support may be required on occasion * Conduct RCCMs (Root Cause Failure Analysis) of failed OFC units * Conduct electrical system modeling for unique deployment configurations * “I Own Safety” leader and facilitator, p rocess changes /implementation and participate/initiate continuous improvement processes **REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS:** * Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or related discipline * A minimum of 7 years of electrical engineering experience in an industrial environment minimum of 3 years in power electronics integration, motion control, turbomachinery or similar * Demonstrated success in hands\-on setup, operation and troubleshooting of complex electrical systems * Ability to use and set up test equipment, such as oscilloscopes, data loggers/analyzers, software development tools, etc. * Familiarity with the safety requirements for high power applications * Understanding of digital, analog and power electronics components and operation * Strong oral and written communication skills * Good interpersonal, project management, presentation, and teamwork skills * Ability to run multiple projects in a fast\-paced engineering environment * Understanding of lean manufacturing principles * Proficient in use of Microsoft Office programs * Ability to travel up to 10\-15% of the time including some international travel * Legal Authorization to work in the United States \- Sponsorship will not be provided for this role **PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS:** * Minimum of 3 years in power electronics integration, motion control, turbomachinery or similar highly preferred * Power electronics troubleshooting experience is preferred * Hands\-on familiarity with industrial communication protocols, such as Modbus and signal level instrumentation, is preferred * Experience in the design of digital, analog and power electronic circuits is a plus * Familiarity with motor controls is a plus * Familiarity with the agency approval process (UL, CE, etc.) is a plus \#LI\-GR1 **Our Commitment to Our People** Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. opportunities, and recommendations for senior leaders. * Build upon a trusted, governed data foundation in partnership with Technology and Data, and modernize management reporting and business processes and create scalable approaches that improve productivity. * Proven experience building, developing, and leading high\-performing teams across analytical, financial, technical, and business disciplines. * Strong understanding of modern data and analytics environments, including data architecture, governance, integration, business intelligence, and self\-service analytics, with information with financial and operational data. * Experience with enterprise planning, forecasting, ERP, data warehouse/lakehouse, or automation platforms, and a strong understanding of AI and advanced analytics with practical business applications. * Ability to partner with data architects, engineers, and technology leaders and translate technical concepts into financial and business outcomes. * Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights and recommendations for senior executives. **Cognitive / Mental Requirements** =================================== * Ability to synthesize large volumes of complex financial, operational, commercial, and technical information to identify meaningful patterns, risks, and opportunities. * Strong analytical reasoning, systems thinking, and judgment, including the ability to structure and solve complex problems where information may be incomplete or ambiguous. strategic and detailed thinking, and to translate between financial, business, analytical, and technical concepts for business, Finance, technical, and executive audiences. * Ability to evaluate competing priorities and alternatives and exercise sound judgment based on business value, scalability, risk, and strategic importance. * Ability to lead through organizational and technological change, manage multiple complex initiatives, and build alignment among stakeholders with differing priorities. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity, sound judgment with jobs.description: **Role:** Senior Cybersecurity Engineer **Location:** \- US **City, State:** Remote **Job Area:** Full time **Job ID:** 202622444 **Job Category:** Technology At **DICK'S Sporting Goods**, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve. If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world's greatest sports team, apply to join our team today! **OVERVIEW:** DICKʼS Inc. is looking for a Senior Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) Engineer. This role will perform as a function within our Cybersecurity and Digital Trust organization, with the primary strength of building, integrating, operating, and migrating scalable CIAM solutions. Our ultimate strategic goal is to combine and consolidate multiple customer identity platforms into a single, unified CIAM solution. This role will be the technical lead for this migration, ensuring a seamless, low\-friction experience for our customers while maintaining a resilient, highly observable, and secure authentication ecosystem. **Core Responsibilities** * CIAM Migration \& Architecture: Lead the architectural design and execution of consolidating our disparate customer identity platforms into a single target solution. * Product Co\-Ownership \& Business Strategy: Partner closely with product, marketing, and various business units to co\-own the identity roadmap. Connect identity data to business intelligence to help drive sales, while balancing security measures against customer friction. * Identity Operations: Own the day\-to\-day lifecycle operations of user accounts, including login flows, multi\-factor authentication (MFA), password resets, account recovery, regular patching, system health checks, and feature rollouts. * Integrations \& Microservices: Develop and maintain advanced API connections and microservices architectures linking the CIAM platform to ancillary systems like customer loyalty programs, CRMs, and marketing tech stacks. * Mobile \& UI Support: Collaborate on or directly support the development of user\-facing interfaces, ensuring the authentication experience on mobile applications is frictionless and intuitive. * Observability \& Resilience: Implement comprehensive logging, monitoring, and alerting configurations to ensure the identity platform is resilient against outages and highly visible to engineering teams. Security \& Incident Response: Serve as a core responder for customer identity\-related security incidents, identifying credential stuffing, bot mitigation, fraud trends, or system vulnerabilities, and mitigating threats in real time. * Business Reviews: Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and assessments to communicate platform health, migration velocity, and fraud metrics to stakeholders. **QUALIFICATIONS:** **Required Skills \& Experience:** * Proven experience successfully executing a full\-scale CIAM platform migration from start to finish. * Identity Technical Depth: Advanced expertise in session token management, authentication protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML), and heavy API\-driven architecture. * Multi\-Platform Knowledge: Hands\-on experience working across multiple major CIAM solutions (e.g., Auth0, Okta, Ping Identity, ForgeRock, AWS Cognito, etc.). Developer Background: Strong coding background with a preferred focus on microservices and building integrations within a complex customer ecosystem \- including CI/CD pipelines. * Mobile UI/UX Experience: Experience developing or heavily influencing user interfaces for mobile applications, specifically around the login and onboarding journeys. * Business Acumen \& Communication: Experience navigating customer\-facing challenges, translating technical risks into business impact, and managing communication strategies for end\-users during major changes. * Fraud \& Friction Analytics: Ability to analyze fraud metrics and find the "sweet spot" where security protects the platform without hurting conversion rates or sales. * Customer Support Optimization: Collaborate with customer care teams to understand and analyze customer support trends; optimizing solution delivery to reduce challenges encountered by support teams, including providing self\-service resolution scenarios. **Preferred \& Added Value Qualifications (Enterprise Consolidation Focus):** * Zero\-Downtime Migration Strategies: Experience utilizing Just\-In\-Time (JIT) user provisioning or migration techniques to move millions of active users without requiring forced, mass password resets. * Data Privacy \& Compliance Regulations: Solid understanding of global data privacy compliance legislation (such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) as it relates to merging customer profile databases and managing user consent. Participate in relevant legal engagements internally and externally as required. * Modern Auth Standards: Familiarity with implementing passwordless authentication, FIDO2, and Passkeys to drive down mobile user friction and eliminate credential\-based attacks. * High\-Volume Scalability: Experience managing identity platforms that handle massive, seasonal traffic spikes (e.g., flash sales, holiday traffic) without latency or degradation. **VIRTUAL REQUIREMENTS:** At DICK'S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments. To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following: * **Cameras must be on** during all virtual interviews. * **AI tools are not permitted** to be used by the candidateduring any part of the interview process. * Offers are contingent upon a **satisfactory background check** which may include **ID verification**. This is part of a competitive total rewards package that could include other components such as: incentive, equity and benefits. Individual pay is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all teammate pay regularly to ensure competitive and equitable pay.DICK'S Sporting Goods complies with all state paid leave requirements. We also offer a generous suite of benefits. Experience building software that leverages large data based applications. Data plays a huge part in the work that we do and how we support our developer partners. You have a sense for product and design. We don’t operate in silos, and you’ll be collaborating closely with cross\-functional peers. jobs.title: Enterprise AI Architect
jobs.description: **About Distyl AI** =================== Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations. We research and deploy technologies that power AI\-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self\-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission\-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys. Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board\-members of 20\+ F500s. **What We Are Looking For** =========================== We are looking for a senior Enterprise AI Architect to serve as the long\-term technical partner to some of Distyl’s most strategic Fortune 500 customers. You will operate more like a senior technical partner than a traditional pre\-sales architect: build trust with C\-suite and technical leaders, bring a strong point of view on where AI can create meaningful business value, shape the solution with the customer, and stay accountable for the technical relationship beyond signature. This role sits in Engineering and works closely with Go\-to\-Market, Product, and Forward\-Deployed Engineering. You will lead the technical arc of an account from early technology conversations and problem shaping through architecture, feasibility, and SOW; for qualified late\-stage pursuits, you will partner with forward deployed engineers to drive implementation of solutions. After close, the Technical Delivery Lead owns day\-to\-day execution while you remain attached for architecture reviews, steering moments, difficult decisions, and expansion. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for someone who has built and delivered production systems, can hold a room with executives, and can translate between business ambition and engineering reality. Success means customers view you as a trusted technical advisor, GTM gets technically credible proposals, and delivery inherits scopes that survive contact with production. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Own the strategic technical relationship.** Serve as the primary technical counterpart for strategic accounts, building trust with CIO/CTO\-level leaders, enterprise architects, and business executives. Help customers identify where AI can materially change an operation, pattern\-match from prior deployments, and shape an ambitious but deliverable technical vision. * **Own architecture, feasibility, prototypes, and technical SOW quality.** Lead joint solution architecture with customer teams, applying Distyl’s platform and technical primitives to real enterprise systems. Use prototypes and demos to validate key assumptions where needed, and own the technical content of the SOW, including integrations, data access, deployment model, dependencies, assumptions, and risks. * **Qualify opportunities and shape technically credible solutions.** Assess whether opportunities are well\-suited for AI, evaluate data, systems, security, integration, and organizational constraints, and make the call on technical feasibility before Distyl commits to scope. * **Turn customer patterns into reusable assets and product feedback.** Translate recurring needs, architecture patterns, security constraints, and deployment learnings into reusable technical assets and concrete feedback that influences Distyl’s platform, product, and engineering roadmap. * **Carry the technical thread from first conversation through successful delivery.** Stay engaged through architecture reviews, executive steering, major tradeoffs, risk escalations, and expansion opportunities, while empowering the delivery lead to own execution. **Who You Are** =============== **Required** * 8\+ years of relevant experience across engineering, enterprise architecture, forward\-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or similar roles, with substantial customer\-facing responsibility. * Hands\-on production delivery experience. You have designed, built, and shipped Enterprise\-grade Agentic AI/ML systems and can reason credibly about implementation tradeoffs, reliability, integration, scale, security, and operating constraints. * Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical advisor to executives: you can build trust, develop a point of view, shape ambiguous problems, influence decisions, and handle high\-stakes technical conversations without relying on a script. * Proven ownership of complex enterprise solution architecture and scope, including the ability to write technical SOW content and align customer teams, GTM, and delivery around what is actually buildable. * Ability to work effectively with FDE / Delivery / Product \& Strategy teams — bringing them in at the right time, using their current implementation depth, and maintaining continuity. * Strong working knowledge of APIs, integrations, cloud and enterprise architecture, data flows, security considerations, and modern AI systems; coding fluency to prototype, inspect systems, and engage deeply with engineers. * Deep domain expertise in one or more enterprise areas such as customer support, voice, MarTech, Cybersecurity, IAM, or Document processing. * Able to travel 25% and meet onsite with customer teams; able to work from our New York or San Francisco office Tuesday–Thursday. **Preferred** * Background in an FDE, engineering, or technical consulting organization where you owned both customer outcomes and technical decisions. * Experience in a partner\-like role at a consulting firm, high\-growth technology company, or enterprise software company with long, C\-suite\-led sales cycles. * Experience at an early\-stage startup and comfort operating in ambiguous environments where the playbook is still being built. **What We Offer** ================= * The base salary range for this role is $200,000 \- $275,000 depending on experience, location, and level. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for meaningful equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package * 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents * Flexible time off * Retirement and financial planning benefits, including access to pre\-tax HSA, FSA, and commuter accounts, 401(k), and financial coaching resources * Comprehensive wellness benefits, including physical fitness, mental well\-being, and fertility and family\-building benefits through Carrot * Complimentary in\-office lunches and snacks provided * Access to state\-of\-the\-art AI models, generous usage of modern AI tools, and real\-world business problems * Ownership of high\-impact projects across top enterprises * A mission\-driven, fast\-moving culture that values curiosity, pragmatism, and excellence Distyl has offices in San Francisco and New York. This role follows a hybrid collaboration model with 3\+ days per week (Tuesday–Thursday) in\-office. We believe diverse perspectives make our work stronger and more impactful. We are an equal opportunity employer and evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Diversified:** Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology. **What to Expect:** At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it. We are seeking an AI Engineer to lead the development and adoption of internal AI\-powered solutions that improve employee productivity, automate business processes, and drive innovation. This role will partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities, define product roadmaps, and deliver AI solutions using tools across the business. This position sits within the internal IT team working alongside the Lead Engineer and Platform team, with direct exposure to the CIO and AI Council. Key Responsibilities * Own the vision, roadmap, and backlog for internal AI products and solutions. * Lead the implementation of AI, automation, and Generative AI solutions for Enterprise Platforms * Build agentic workflows, prompt engineering and evaluation pipelines, agent orchestration layer, LLM gateway integration, RAG pipelines and model evaluation and monitoring * Identify and prioritize AI use cases that deliver measurable business value. * Partner with the AI Council and business stakeholders to gather requirements and define product features. * Collaborate with architects, developers, data engineers, and business teams. * Monitor solution performance, usage, and business outcomes. * Ensure AI solutions comply with security, privacy, and governance standards. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend future capabilities. Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or related field. * 5\+ years of experience in technology, product management, business systems, AI, or digital transformation. * Experience with building Enterprise AI platforms and Agentic workflows * Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and product ownership practices. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Key Skills * AI \& Generative AI Solutions * Agentic workflows and frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar * Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and others * RAG pipelines and Graphs * Product Ownership \& Roadmap Management * Business Process Automation * Requirements Gathering * Change Management * Stakeholder Engagement * Agile Project Delivery Why Join Us? Help shape the future of work by building AI solutions that transform how our employees collaborate, make decisions, and serve our customers. This role offers the opportunity to lead enterprise AI initiatives and influence the organization's AI strategy. \#Li\-Remote **What We Offer:** We believe great people deserve great benefits. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and work\-life balance: * Multiple medical plan options to fit you and your family’s needs * HSA \& HRA company contributions * Dental coverage, including orthodontic benefits, and vision plans Company\-paid benefits * Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Generous paid time off — 3 weeks PTO plus company holidays and floating holidays * 401k with company match * Paid maternity leave * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * A wide range of voluntary benefits including Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Pet Insurance, Homeowners and Auto Insurance, Supplemental Life and AD\&D coverage, and Legal Services * Commuter benefits * And much more

Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology. **What to Expect:** At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it. We are seeking an AI Engineer to lead the development and adoption of internal AI\-powered solutions that improve employee productivity, automate business processes, and drive innovation. This role will partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities, define product roadmaps, and deliver AI solutions using tools across the business. This position sits within the internal IT team working alongside the Lead Engineer and Platform team, with direct exposure to the CIO and AI Council. Key Responsibilities * Own the vision, roadmap, and backlog for internal AI products and solutions. * Lead the implementation of AI, automation, and Generative AI solutions for Enterprise Platforms * Build agentic workflows, prompt engineering and evaluation pipelines, agent orchestration layer, LLM gateway integration, RAG pipelines and model evaluation and monitoring * Identify and prioritize AI use cases that deliver measurable business value. * Partner with the AI Council and business stakeholders to gather requirements and define product features. * Collaborate with architects, developers, data engineers, and business teams. * Monitor solution performance, usage, and business outcomes. * Ensure AI solutions comply with security, privacy, and governance standards. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend future capabilities. Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or related field. * 5\+ years of experience in technology, product management, business systems, AI, or digital transformation. * Experience with building Enterprise AI platforms and Agentic workflows * Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and product ownership practices. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Key Skills * AI \& Generative AI Solutions * Agentic workflows and frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar * Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and others * RAG pipelines and Graphs * Product Ownership \& Roadmap Management * Business Process Automation * Requirements Gathering * Change Management * Stakeholder Engagement * Agile Project Delivery Why Join Us? Help shape the future of work by building AI solutions that transform how our employees collaborate, make decisions, and serve our customers. This role offers the opportunity to lead enterprise AI initiatives and influence the organization's AI strategy. \#Li\-Remote **What We Offer:** We believe great people deserve great benefits. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and work\-life balance: * Multiple medical plan options to fit you and your family’s needs * HSA \& HRA company contributions * Dental coverage, including orthodontic benefits, and vision plans Company\-paid benefits * Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Generous paid time off — 3 weeks PTO plus company holidays and floating holidays * 401k with company match * Paid maternity leave * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * A wide range of voluntary benefits including Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Pet Insurance, Homeowners and Auto Insurance, Supplemental Life and AD\&D coverage, and Legal Services * Commuter benefits * And much more

jobs.title: (1112149) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) - Application Support
jobs.description: **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Application Support** Diversified Services Network, Inc. (DSN) is seeking a full\-time Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Application Support to join our team in their choice of our Chicago, IL or Peoria, IL office locations. We offer a full hybrid work model, requiring 2 days of onsite work per week, benefits, PTO, 401k, and more! If you're looking to grow your career within an extremely reputable, stable Fortune 100 company \- let's talk! **Position Overview** We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Application Support to triage, investigate, and resolve support tickets for critical business applications, ensuring availability and performance are maintained against defined Service Level Agreements. This role combines hands\-on application support with automation and monitoring work, and includes periodic off\-shift and weekend support coverage. **Key Responsibilities** * Triage and resolve support tickets in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs). * Identify and resolve critical application and technical problems, including responding to off\-shift and weekend support calls. * Investigate tickets and perform statistical analysis and testing of application failures. * Proactively identify and manage issue resolution, documenting the process and providing follow\-up to requestors. * Monitor application availability and performance on an ongoing basis. * Develop scripts and automation tools to better detect and correct application issues. * Build monitoring and alerting capabilities to proactively surface application issues. * Collaborate cross\-functionally, including occasional coordination with external partner/dealer communications. * Perform additional duties as assigned. **Requirements** **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's or Master's degree with 2–4 years of experience in Application Support for cloud\-based applications; OR * No degree with a relevant technical certification and 6\+ years of comparable experience. **Required Technical Skills** * Expertise supporting, querying, and reporting on relational databases, preferably Snowflake. * Experience with AWS services: EC2, S3, VPC, Route 53, RDS, CloudFormation, DynamoDB, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, Certificate Manager, ELB, EBS, ECS, CloudFront/WAF, SQS, SNS, and SES. * Experience troubleshooting issues related to UI, API, and data flow. * Expertise with high\-availability architecture. * Experience with monitoring tools (e.g., ThousandEyes, AppDynamics, Grafana). * Background in data management, data engineering, or data operations; familiarity with ADO pipeline framework a plus. * Experience with Python or a related scripting language for automation. * Experience in a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) capacity, improving application availability and performance. * Working knowledge of Python, PowerShell, SQL, and JSON. * Working knowledge of autoscaling deployment concepts (hands\-on configuration not required). **Benefits** * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Vision Insurance * Disability insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Paid Holidays Please follow the link to our website for a list of job openings in Engineering, IT, Project Management, and more! https://www.dsnworldwide.com Salary expectations: 95,000\-100,000 per annual

Operating from the Jenks, Oklahoma facility are the Tulsa Winch, Rufnek, Greer, dp Winch and Gear Products brands with Pullmaster and LANTEC brands operating from the Surrey, British Columbia, Canada. By drawing upon the talent of our dedicated employees and the strengths of these brands, TWG has become known around the world for providing innovative products and solutions designed and manufactured to high quality standards and delivered to our customers on time. The products and solutions produced by TWG find their way into diverse applications including onshore oil and gas, the utility industry, commercial and governmental towing and recovery, construction and offshore cranes, marine applications including fishing and cargo handling, forestry and mining applications and a myriad of other construction applications.
