jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobs.description: **About Payoneer** Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories. By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi\-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence. **Role summary** PAYO Digital Bank, N.A. (PDB), Payoneer's national trust bank subsidiary, is seeking a deeply experienced Senior Staff Engineer to serve as the technical anchor of the bank's engineering organization and the architect of record for its core transactional systems. You will own the design of the integration between the core banking ledger and the stablecoin issuance engine: the system of record that reconciles fiat reserves, on\-chain token supply, and customer balances with bank\-grade accuracy and auditability. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on architecture and leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer of PDB, providing technical direction to the core team of engineers. The ideal candidate is a distributed systems expert with high\-integrity transactional experience (banking core, payments ledger, exchange, or settlement infrastructure). Our training and inference network is trustless, and the workers are GPUs scattered across the world. Many things can go wrong in this system. An inference worker can return tokens from a cheaper model, or a highly quantized version of the one it's supposed to run. Even with the right model, it can sample with the wrong parameters. Training faces its own attacks, and Agora showed what a permissionless run deals with in practice: participants who disrupt training by dropping updates or flooding the system, free\-riders who submit trivial work and collect the rewards, poisoned updates that plant backdoors, attempts to extract private data from gradients and activations, and contributors who inflate their reported work to claim rewards they didn't earn. Sentinel is our first published answer on the training side. Your primary role is to come up with efficient algorithms and systems that verify the work: that tokens came from the claimed model and sampling parameters, and that training contributions are what they claim to be. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Own the threat model**: You enumerate what a malicious or careless worker can do across pre\-training, post\-training, and inference — training disruption and denial\-of\-service, free\-riding, model poisoning and backdoors, data extraction from gradients and activations, reputation and reward manipulation — and you keep that model current as the network grows. * **Design and calibrate the tests**: You build statistical verification methods with stated error rates, tune them with rigorous benchmarks, and keep false positives and false negatives controlled across heterogeneous hardware, including different GPUs and Macs. * **Ship the verifier**: You build and run the verification service in the inference path, and you live with its mistakes. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **Verification systems, shipped or published**: You've built a calibrated statistical decision system with stated error rates and lived with its mistakes. jobs.description: **Job title:** JR. Payment Certification Specialist **Reports to:** Card Payment Supervisor **Department:** Acquiring **Location:** Alpharetta, GA (Hybrid) **Grade:** 14 **About Priority Commerce:** Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy\-to\-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue \- empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter. We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities. At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to be known for results \- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive. **About the Role:** In this position you will work with our payments team, both business and certification specialists on all level 1 transaction testing. You will work closely with different terminals/vendors and various development teams and partners including acquiring banks, card schemes and labs to ensure all certification requirements have been met. You will monitor real\-time payments across the different API channels available to merchants. **Responsibilities:** * In charge of the EMV Certification Intake Process. * Validate certification prerequisites including EMVCO, PCI and TQM. * Conduct testing and certification and document test results. Analyze test results with senior team members and engineers using troubleshooting skills to determine possible failure points. * Manage all internal and third\-party test tools and create and maintain test plans including vendor\-provided test cases. * Report and maintain status of all transaction testing related to any ongoing certification and non\-certification projects. * Be responsible for assessing and evaluating quality assurance test requirements to determine the scope of the functionality to be covered by testing based on platform, message specifications, connectivity, market and features. * Creating and maintaining API payment scenarios. * Assisting the integrated solutions team validating partner integrations test results. * Stay informed with upcoming payment changes and internal production deployments. * Review network/vendor technical changes documentation and determine impact to our systems. * Fulfill other responsibilities as assigned. **Candidate Requirements:** * Minimum 2 years’ experience in payment processing and card brand certifications. * Two years’ experience with merchant point\-of\-sale technology. * Knowledge of Microsoft Office and G\-Suites. * Strong communication skills both written and verbal. * Be a self\-starter in a cross\-functional environment. * Team\-player who can also work independently. * Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines. * Strong attention to detail. * Adaptability. **Work Environment \& Culture:** We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand \- an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results\-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie. Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results. **Compensation and Benefits:** **Compensation range:** $55k \- $60k We invest in the whole employee \- personally and professionally. jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description: **Implementation Manager** ========================== **About Us** ------------ Proton is building the AI operating system for wholesale distribution, embedded in the workflows that move nearly every physical product on the planet. Distribution is a $9 trillion industry running on software that has been stuck for decades. We unify CRM, PIM, eCommerce AI, and Order \& Quote Entry AI into one platform with one data layer and one AI brain, so reps spend their time on customer relationships instead of data entry. We have been building AI into distribution long before it became an industry buzzword. That head start matters, and we've only deepened the investment by shipping the first AI assistant embedded in a distribution CRM and launching a complete agentic product in our PIM offering. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. Everyone here is a builder who owns problems end to end and ships AI\-native software faster than anyone else in the category. The median Proton customer reports 3x profit return per dollar spent and an extra day of sales per rep per month. Hundreds of distributors run on Proton, from family\-owned shops to publicly\-traded enterprises. We're backed by Felicis Ventures and Battery Ventures. **The Role** ------------ We're hiring an Implementation Manager to own standard customer engagements from pre\-sales solutioning through a successful go\-live. As part of Forward Deployed Engineering, you'll be the customer\-facing owner of the plan, the work, and the outcome—translating real distributor workflows into an implementation that delivers value quickly and sticks. Implementation here means more than a handoff after a deal closes. You'll help Sales shape a workable solution before signature, define scope and success criteria, lead the project through configuration, integrations, data, testing, training, and go\-live, then leave the customer set up to run on Proton. You'll act as the engagement lead for standard implementations: equally comfortable driving details, aligning senior stakeholders, and surfacing what needs to change. You'll partner with Engineering and Engagement Managers when scope, technical risk, or stakeholder complexity exceeds the standard path. This role is designed as a growth path into an Engagement Manager role driving complex customer engagements. **Location:** Cambridge, MA. Hybrid, 3 days a week in our Harvard Square office. **Customer travel:** Occasional travel to customer sites, including distribution centers, is expected. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Partner in pre\-sales solutioning. Join discovery and solution\-design conversations, turn requirements into clear scopes and phased plans, surface dependencies and risks early, and make sure what is sold can be implemented well. * **Lead the delivery plan.** Take each project from signed agreement through go\-live: kickoff, project plan, configuration, integrations, data readiness, testing, training, and cutover. Keep every workstream moving and every owner clear. * **Run stakeholder governance and risk.** Establish the right cadence with customer champions, technical teams, and executives. Keep decisions and risks visible, escalate early when a plan needs to change, and resolve issues before they become surprises. * Translate business workflows into a technical plan. Get close to how a distributor sells, quotes, manages products, and enters orders; then work with customers and Proton teammates to configure the right workflow, data model, and integration approach. * **Drive integration and data work with good judgment.** You do not need to be the engineer writing every integration, but you can assess API, source\-system, data\-quality, and integration risks well enough to make tradeoffs visible and bring in the right technical owner. * Make go\-live real. Define acceptance criteria, lead UAT and readiness reviews, prepare users for change, coordinate cutover, and stay close enough after launch to ensure the new workflow is actually adopted. * **Own implementation outcomes.** Track time to value, on\-time go\-lives, activation, implementation CSAT, and project health. Forecast risk honestly and act early when a plan needs to change. * Build the repeatable motion. Turn lessons from customers into sharper playbooks, templates, estimates, product feedback, and sales enablement. Help make each normal implementation faster, clearer, and better than the last. **What You'll Need to Succeed** ------------------------------- * **Implementation and project\-management experience.** 2\+ years in implementation, technical project delivery, professional services, or a comparable role, with demonstrated ownership of customer outcomes. Early\-stage B2B SaaS experience is a plus. * Technical fluency. You can work productively with APIs, integrations, data models, source systems, and configuration. You ask precise questions, identify risk, and can hold your own with customer technical teams and senior engineers. * Pre\-sales judgment. You can turn ambiguous customer needs into an implementable plan, distinguish a requirement from a nice\-to\-have, surface constraints without creating friction, and protect the path to value. * Excellent execution under real\-world constraints. You know how to build and run a project plan, coordinate dependencies, make decisions visible, and move multiple workstreams forward without losing the detail. * Customer\-facing range. You're as comfortable in a warehouse aisle with an operations team as you are running a meeting with senior stakeholders. You'd rather understand the work firsthand than manage by secondhand notes. * Clear communication and calm ownership. You can explain technical tradeoffs in plain language, earn trust quickly, and keep customers and internal teams aligned when things are messy. * **Practical use of AI in your own work.** You regularly use AI tools to accelerate planning, analysis, documentation, and coordination, and know how to provide context, evaluate outputs, and correct mistakes. * Data\-driven and adaptive thinking. You use project and customer data to decide what needs attention, while staying flexible as details change. * High agency and a continuous improvement mindset. You look for the root cause, close the loop, and improve the system rather than just getting through the current project. **Big Plus** ------------ * Complex B2B, enterprise, or ERP\-adjacent software, with high\-frequency users and operational workflows people can't opt out of. * Wholesale distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or another operationally complex industry. * CRM, PIM, eCommerce, order management, or systems\-of\-record integrations. * Experience delivering AI\-enabled workflows in a customer environment, including the trust, correction, and handoff patterns that make them useful. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- The target base\-salary range for this role is **$100,000–$120,000, plus meaningful equity.** Final offers will be based on your skills and previous experience. * Company\-sponsored 401(k) program * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Unlimited PTO (and we mean it, we want you to take time off) \+ 10 company\-paid holidays * 12 weeks fully paid parental leave, primary and secondary caregivers, including adoption and fostering * Professional development (get that book, take that course, attend that conference) * Access to the AI tools that make you faster, and encouragement to find new ones * Annual company\-paid offsites * A friendly, inclusive, human\-first team that blends hustle, productivity, and fun Proton.ai is an equal opportunity employer. Proton.ai participates in the E\-Verify program: Notice of E\-Verify Participation, Right to Work.

jobs.title: Creative Technologist, Marketing
jobs.description: We build production AI systems for enterprises. We are an AI\-first systems integrator and a Select\-tier partner in Anthropic's Claude Partner Network, among the first integrators selected. The work is good. Most people have never heard of it. That is the job. We are looking for one person who can tell the story of what we build and build things themselves. Not a marketer who uses AI tools. Not an engineer who writes copy. Someone who moves between the two without noticing the border. We build production AI systems for enterprises. Financial services, healthcare companies, PE\-backed operators. We are a Select\-tier partner in Anthropic's Claude Partner Network, among the first integrators selected. Every one of those systems has two stories. What we built, and why it changed the economics of the business that bought it. Most technical marketing tells the first and bores the buyer. We want one person who can tell both, and build things themselves. Not a marketer who uses AI tools. Not an engineer who writes copy. Someone who moves between the two without noticing the border.### **What you will do:** Tell both halves of the story. Sit close to the teams shipping these systems, understand what was actually hard, and translate it into video, writing, and demos that travel. Then go a level up: what the system changed for the operator, what it cost, what it replaced, why the CFO signed. Shape how Provectus is positioned. Not just the case studies but the argument above them. What we stand for, which problems we claim, where we say no. You will have a real hand in that, not a style guide to follow. Build the tools that make the marketing work. A scraper that watches what our market is saying. An agent that drafts case studies from delivery artifacts. A microsite for a launch. A dashboard showing which stories moved pipeline. You write the code. You do not file a ticket and wait. Own channels outright. Write, publish, and measure across LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and whatever channel matters six months from now that does not matter today. Run experiments and kill the ones that lose. Real budget, real autonomy, in exchange for showing your numbers.### **What we are looking for:** You have shipped things people used. A side project, a channel with an audience, a tool, a launch. We care more about what you made than where you worked. You write well, and you have a point of view. You can hold attention for 90 seconds on video and 900 words on a page. You are curious about how companies make money. You can read a business case and find the part that actually matters. You can sit with a CFO or a PE operator and not reach for features. You code. Python or TypeScript, comfortably. You use Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent every day and you have opinions about them. You have built something agentic that does actual work. You are interested in AI for real. You read the papers, or the people who read the papers, and you have changed your mind about something in the last six months. You are anywhere from your first job to your tenth year. Three levels, one bar: what have you made. If you are early, show us an internship where the bar was high and a portfolio with range. If you are senior, tell us what you built with your own hands in the last 90 days. You are in New York or San Francisco, or you will be. ### **What we offer:** * Base salary of $80,000 to $180,000 depending on level and location, plus a performance bonus. * Direct access to the people building the systems and the executives selling them. Small team, no layers between you and the work. * A budget for tools, models, and experiments, with no approval chain under a threshold. * Promotion tied to output, not tenure. * 401(k) profit sharing plan after probation period * Unlimited PTO policy * Medical, Visual and Dental insurance ### **How to apply:** No cover letter. Send three links: something you wrote, something you built, and something you posted that got a reaction. One paragraph on why the third one worked. Then, two sentences on a company whose positioning you think is wrong and what you would change. Base salary depends on level and location, plus a performance bonus. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Embedded Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing\-in\-ground\-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next\-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo \- connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before. Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward\-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production \- and building the team to make it happen. **Role Overview** ================= As an **Embedded Systems Software Engineer**, you’ll play a role in developing and certifying our Seaglider product family. You’ll contribute to embedded software development, simulation testing, and hands\-on electronics work, helping ensure our platform stays reliable, testable, and ready to evolve. From managing real\-time software and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing to wiring up harnesses and spinning up GUIs, your work will directly impact how we prototype, validate, and push the boundaries of our tech. You’ll also collaborate closely with our controls, avionics, and modeling teams to ensure a smooth path from concept to demo \- both on the bench and at sea. If you’re energized by working at the intersection of cutting\-edge innovation, real\-world impact, and hands\-on engineering, you’ll be in the right place \- and we’d be thrilled to have you on the team! **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Contribute to Seaglider product family embedded software stack:** Develop, debug, and maintain the real\-time software that runs on our Seaglider product family, from microcontroller code to Linux\-based applications. * **Support test environment development and testing:** Contribute towards development of the SIL and HIL test environment for verification of controls software. This will include coordinating with multiple disciplinary teams. * **Manage COTS electronics \& harnessing:** Set up and maintain the electronics ecosystem \- from sensors and servos to single\-board computers, harnesses, and breakout boards. * **Improve developer tools and processes:** Automate build systems, streamline deployment pipelines, and build tooling to facilitate maintenance and certification. * **Prototype and field\-test:** Be a key part of the sea trials team \- monitoring operation, running diagnostics, troubleshooting in the field, and reliably showing off our latest and greatest Seaglider capabilities. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Demonstrated experience writing C\+\+ for embedded systems \- whether on Linux, RTOS, or bare metal * Strong hands\-on experience with microcontrollers and common embedded interfaces (Serial, SPI, CAN, PWM, ADCs, DIO, etc.) * Ability to read, interpret, and contribute to wiring diagrams and electrical schematics * Comfortable scripting with Python, MATLAB, or similar languages **Bonus Experience** -------------------- * Experience with LabVIEW or Simulink for DAQ and HIL systems * Familiarity with actuation systems like servo motors * Field\-testing experience and a knack for troubleshooting electronics in real\-world environments * Experience building safety\-critical applications * Familiarity with aerospace or automotive standards like DO\-178C or ISO 26262 **Who We're Looking For** ------------------------- * **Collaborative Team Player:** You believe that great things happen when teams work together. You communicate effectively and collaborate with engineers, stakeholders, and other cross\-functional teams to align on goals and move projects forward. You bring people together, ensuring that everyone is on the same page and moving towards a shared vision. * **Creative Problem Solver**: You thrive on tackling complex challenges and finding innovative solutions. You don't just patch issues \- you improve processes, anticipate downstream impacts, and help turn one\-off fixes into scalable solutions that raise the bar for future builds. * **Adaptable \& Agile:** In a fast\-paced, ever\-evolving startup environment, you quickly adapt to changing priorities and requirements. You approach challenges with a calm, resilient mindset, and know how to pivot and adjust your approach as needed, ensuring that progress continues without missing a beat. * **Innovative Mindset**: You’re driven by curiosity and a passion for technology. You’re passionate about driving continuous improvement, embracing new technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and team performance. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Competitive compensation** including a robust equity incentive plan. * Comprehensive **health, dental, and vision insurance \-** we cover **100%** of your premiums. * **401(k)** with company matching, so you can plan for the future. * Generous **flexible time off**, paid parental leave, and company\-wide holiday breaks. * **Relocation packages** available for those moving to join our team. * Daily, **free catered lunches** * Learning \& professional development opportunities **If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you.** Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Headquartered in San Mateo, California with more than 4,000 employees worldwide, the Rakuten International business portfolio includes market leaders in e\-commerce, digital marketing, advertising, communications and entertainment. We create products and services that provide exceptional value by aligning members and the businesses that want to engage them in a shared community. **Job Summary:** We are seeking an innovative and dedicated Software Engineer to join the Rakuten AI User Experience team. Rakuten AI strives to be your Rakuten AI companion, providing the best AI user experience — generally, contextually, and personally. Rakuten AI aims to serve as the AI Core of the Rakuten ecosystem, enhancing interconnections between Rakuten services and users to delight customers worldwide more than ever before. This role involves advancing the AI user experience to serve as the foundational core across the Rakuten products ecosystem by developing innovative AI user experience framework. You can visit rakuten.us and our Muse profile , to learn more about Rakuten’s culture and values. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Develop and Maintain Web Applications** : Design, build, and maintain React, Angular, or Vue to create intuitive and responsive user interfaces. * **Develop AI Back\-End Services** : Build server\-side logic and APIs using technologies like Node.js, Python, Java, or Ruby. * **Building highly flexible, scalable Agentic AI Framework** by leveraging popular AI toolset like LangChain etc. * **Data schema design and database management** : Design and manage databases, jobs.title: Smart Contract Developer
jobs.description: Smart Contract DeveloperBuild the on\-chain layer of modern financial products Robinhood builds technology that gives users access to investing and trading through a unified digital experience. Across its products, customers can interact with stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, futures, portfolio tools, market data, and other financial services. As blockchain becomes a larger part of modern financial infrastructure, we’re looking for a **Smart Contract Developer** to work on secure, production\-grade on\-chain systems and the services that connect them with broader financial products. This role goes beyond writing isolated Solidity contracts. You’ll work across smart contract architecture, blockchain integrations, testing, security, transaction flows, and the infrastructure required to bring on\-chain functionality into real\-world applications. What you’ll do * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain production\-grade smart contracts. * Build reusable contract architecture for blockchain and crypto\-related product functionality. * Develop integrations between smart contracts, backend services, wallets, APIs, and on\-chain data. * Implement transaction, signing, permission, asset\-transfer, and contract\-interaction flows. * Write comprehensive unit, integration, and invariant/fuzz tests for contract systems. * Review contract logic for security vulnerabilities, edge cases, and unintended economic behavior. * Optimize contracts for gas efficiency without compromising readability or security. * Participate in technical design and architecture discussions for new blockchain functionality. * Investigate protocol\-level issues and production incidents involving on\-chain components. * Review code and help establish standards for secure smart contract development. * Follow developments across Ethereum, EVM ecosystems, DeFi, wallet infrastructure, and blockchain security. What we’re looking for * Strong experience developing smart contracts with **Solidity**. * Solid understanding of the **EVM, transaction lifecycle, calldata, storage, events, signatures, and gas mechanics**. * Experience with development frameworks such as **Foundry or Hardhat**. * Understanding of common smart contract vulnerabilities and defensive development patterns. * Experience integrating contracts with TypeScript/JavaScript, backend services, RPC providers, and Web3 libraries. * Strong testing and debugging skills, including experience working with testnets and forked environments. * Familiarity with token standards such as **ERC\-20, ERC\-721, ERC\-1155**, and related EVM standards. * Understanding of upgradeability, access control, multisig, oracle, and contract permission models. * Ability to independently take a smart contract system from technical specification through deployment and maintenance. Experience with **DeFi protocols, DEX infrastructure, custody systems, bridges, account abstraction, smart contract auditing, formal verification, or financial applications** is a strong advantage. Engineering where finance meets blockchain Robinhood operates across both traditional and crypto markets rather than treating blockchain as an isolated product category. Its current trading offering spans equities, options, crypto and futures, creating an environment where financial engineering and modern software infrastructure increasingly intersect. For a Smart Contract Developer, that means solving problems where correctness matters. On\-chain software handles assets and irreversible state transitions, so security, testing, observability, and careful architecture are fundamental parts of the engineering process. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to blockchain functionality while working alongside engineers dealing with financial systems, trading infrastructure, security, data, and consumer\-facing products. What you can expect You’ll work on technically challenging systems with meaningful ownership from design through production. We value engineers who can reason about adversarial conditions, question unsafe assumptions, communicate trade\-offs clearly, and build systems that remain reliable beyond the happy path. Pay: $73,000\.00 \- $155,460\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Flextime * Tuition reimbursement * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: We believe that mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms. We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one's overall well\-being. We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence\-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare. Rula is a remote\-first company. We currently hire in most U.S. states, with the exception of Hawaii. **About the Role** We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join Rula’s Patient Onboarding team, which owns the journey from a person’s first interaction with Rula through registration, insurance verification, and successfully getting started with care. You’ll be a hands\-on technical leader, writing code while leading complex initiatives across product areas, improving the foundations our team builds on, and helping other engineers move faster through strong technical direction and modern AI\-enabled development practices. Our collaborative team moves quickly, works closely with Product, Design, and Analytics, and gives engineers meaningful ownership over both what we build and how we build it. This role offers the opportunity to improve a critical part of Rula’s patient experience while shaping the systems and engineering practices that help us connect more people to care. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience operating at Staff\-level scope or leading complex initiatives across multiple teams or systems. * Strong full\-stack engineering experience building and maintaining production web applications, with depth in modern frontend frameworks, backend APIs, data modeling, and distributed systems. * Demonstrated experience leading technically complex projects from problem definition through design, implementation, launch, and production support. * Experience working on high\-impact user journeys such as onboarding, checkout, registration, eligibility, payments, marketplaces, or other conversion\-critical workflows. * Demonstrated experience influencing technical direction across functions or teams, including communicating tradeoffs and driving alignment with Product, Design, Data, or other engineering teams. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted software development tools (such as Claude Code) as part of regular engineering workflows. **Preferred Qualifications** *While having the preferred qualifications enhances your candidacy, having all of them is not mandatory. We encourage all interested applicants to apply, even those who may not meet every preferred requirement.* * Experience building AI\-powered engineering workflows, tooling, or automation that was adopted by others and measurably improved development speed or quality. * Experience in healthcare, insurance, fintech, or another regulated domain where reliability, privacy, and complex business rules materially influence system design. * Experience using product, operational, or funnel data to identify technical opportunities and evaluate whether engineering investments produced the intended outcome. * Demonstrated ability to improve engineering leverage across a small team through tooling, documentation, shared architecture, or reducing concentrated system knowledge **We're serious about your well\-being! As part of our team, full\-time employees receive:** * **100% remote work environment:** Working hours to support a healthy work\-life balance, ensuring you can meet both professional and personal commitments (must be based in United States, currently not hiring in Hawaii) * **Attractive pay and benefits**: Full transparency of pay ranges regardless of where you live in the United States * **Comprehensive health benefits**: Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and FSA/HSA * **401(k) plan access**: Start saving for your future * **Generous time\-off policies**: Including 2 company\-wide shutdown weeks each year for self\-care (for most employees) * **Paid parental leave**: Available for all parents, including birthing, non\-birthing, adopting, and fostering * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)**: Supporting your mental and physical health * **Quarterly department stipend**: Fun team\-building activities or in\-person gatherings * **Community and employee resource groups**: Participate in groups that celebrate employee identity and lived experiences, fostering a sense of community and belonging for all * **Home office stipend:** New hire home office stipend \& $50 monthly stipend to help cover internet or cell phone expenses * **Wellness at Rula program:** Year\-round wellness initiatives and a $50/month wellness stipend **Our team** We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental to our mission of making mental healthcare work for everyone. We are dedicated to having a culture of inclusion that will support our employees in feeling safe, seen, heard, and valued. Compensation Range: $192K \- $240K

jobs.title: Pre-Sales Engineer (B2B SaaS Industry)
jobs.description: At Rydoo, we make expense management simple, so people can focus on the important work, not their receipts. More than one million users trust us to submit, approve, and control expenses faster and smarter. Semine shares that same mission. Since 2015, the team has been building AI technology that removes the repetitive, time\-consuming parts of accounting, helping finance teams work smarter. In July 2025, Semine joined forces with Rydoo to shape the future of financial automation. Together, we’re creating a complete, AI\-powered platform that simplifies accounts payable and expense management, helping businesses run simpler, faster and smarter financial operations. We’re a global team of \+250 people who believe great tech should make life easier. If you have big ideas and want to build something that actually helps people, you’ll fit right in. Rydoo in a snapshot* Ambitious international team 250\+ * 33 nationalities speaking over 15 languages * 6 offices across 3 continents * Easy\-to\-use spend management app rated 4\.6 on Gartner Peer Insights, available on iPhone and Android * Supporting over 10,000\+ clients and 1 million\+ users worldwide * 4\.5 employer score on Glassdoor, with 92% of employees saying they would recommend us * Hybrid work policy **The Role** As a Pre\-Sales Engineer you are the connection between technology and business, helping finance leaders understand how Rydoo's expense management platform solves the problems they actually have: controlling spend, enforcing policy without slowing people down, and closing the books faster. Working alongside our US Account Executives across mid\-market and enterprise, you will run technical discovery, design and deliver tailored demonstrations, scope integrations into ERP and HCM environments, and own our RFP responses. Today our AEs run most of this themselves with support arriving from Europe, hours ahead of their calendar. You are the person who changes that. You will also be a cornerstone of how solution engineering takes shape in North America, with real influence over the demo standard, the RFP library, and how our AEs and SEs sell together. Mid\-market is our core market and where most of your time will go. Our enterprise deals are global, multi\-country and genuinely complex, and you will work those too. Your impact* Own technical discovery and deliver tailored demonstrations across US and Canadian opportunities, from 100\-person companies to global enterprises * Translate finance pain into solution design, and hold the business conversation with a CFO before the technical one with their IT lead * Lead technical validation on enterprise deals: ERP and HCM integration scoping, SSO and security reviews, multi\-country and multi\-currency configuration, card programs * Own RFP and RFI responses for North America and build the response library behind them * Build and maintain the US demo environment, including industry and persona\-specific configurations * Partner with Technical Services on scope handover at close, and bring US market and competitive signal back to Product * Set the technical standard for a growing US sales team through competitive positioning and demo coaching **Requirements** * 3\+ years in pre\-sales, solution engineering, or solution consulting for B2B SaaS sold to finance, HR, or IT buyers * A track record running demos and technical validation in enterprise or upper mid\-market deals * Strong understanding of finance and accounting workflows * Working knowledge of the integration landscape our buyers live in: ERP, HCM and payroll platforms, SSO, APIs and data flows * Experience supporting formal RFP and RFI processes * Proven ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both business and technical audiences, and to stay composed presenting to a large mixed audience * Comfort in a team\-selling model where the Account Executive owns the relationship and you own the solution Nice to have* Travel and expense, spend management, or fintech background * Multi\-country or multi\-currency deployment experience * Experience as the first or early Solution Engineer in a region * Interest in growing into accounts payable: Rydoo's Semine AP platform comes to the US market in 2027 and this role can extend into it **Practicalities:*** You'll be reporting to the VP of Sales, Americas * You'll be part of the Sales team * Location: Atlanta, GA **Benefits** Next to our amazing team, informal \& international company culture, and our mission to become the \#1 spend management tool worldwide, we offer some great perks: * Competitive compensation package * Health Insurance * 401K Plan * Travel Insurance * Equipment: * + Company phone will be provided + Phone subscription: The employee can choose a provider and expense it, Rydoo covers up to $150 / month + Company laptop will be provided * Learning \& Development Budget: 1,000 USD per year * 28 vacation days per year * A diverse, global team with 33\+ nationalities * Fantastic onboarding program for all new Rydoo’ers **Check us out** LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/rydoo Glassdoor: http://bit.ly/2UujjWJ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/wearerydoo/ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTZYj7vm\_ZcsGFL18jWHt\_A Inside Rydoo Blog: https://www.rydoo.com/inside\-rydoo/ **Join Rydoo and leave your mark on the future of Spend Management – Ready to join?**

Non\-Released manufacturing and then through integration into production. **Essential Functions/Responsibilities:*** Using CAD software (Solidworks), Design all mechanical elements of either manual, project costing and margin requirements with applications engineering. * Develops clear, measurable requirements for success based on the established standards and in concert with project teams. * evaluation of suppliers, their quotations and cost control of the project budget. * Ensures the project delivered is compliant with all relevant OSHA, ANSI and local standards in respect to the design and engineering work practices. * Conduct regular project meetings with the project team throughout the project on: + Machine/Equipment/Tooling design and status. + Controls/Systems design and status. * Review project specifications, deliverables and requirement with applications engineering. * Track all changes with a written Project Change Notification and maintains a revision summary. * Record, address and resolves issues that impact project timing and/or scope. * Develop contingency plans or recovery plans as required. * Monitor the timing and cost of the fabrication to deliver the project on time and within budget. *\*The responsibilities as defined are intended to serve as a general guideline for this position.**Associates may be asked to perform additional tasks depending on strengths and capabilities.\** **Required Experience:*** 3\-5 years relevant working experience in: * Automation Machine Design (optional) * Design for Manufacturing * High Speed Assembly Equipment (optional) * Machine Tools * Precision Tooling * Machine Control Systems (optional) * 3\-5 years relevant experience in project management is preferred. * Solid interpersonal communication skills, a professional demeanor, cooperative personality and a team attitude are all required. Works well with others and interacts effectively and efficiently with internal and external people and groups. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to use SolidWorks and MS Office Suite, MS Project, SharePoint Document Management and general computer literacy. * Extensive cross functional team expertise including technical and non\-technical work. * Analytical and creative thinker, problem solver, result\-orientated and focused. * Highly organized, ability to prioritize a varied and fast\-changing workload. * Motivated, high achiever, persistent and conscientious. * Must be able to sit/stand for at least 90 consecutive minutes and not suffer from any sensory deprivation and/or paralysis of the limbs. **Education:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or Manufacturing Engineering from an ABET Accredited College or other equivalent work experience * Experience will be considered in lieu of educational requirements.

jobs.title: Optoelectronics R&D Technical Leader
jobs.description: Samtec is seeking an Optoelectronics R\&D Technical Leader to join our team in the Silicon Valley Design Center. located in in Santa Clara, CA. Our Optoelectronics R\&D Technical Leader owns the technical direction and decisions for designing and developing optical transceiver products. They lead a technical team of multiple engineering disciplines in EE, RF signal integrity, optics, mechanical, thermal, firmware, and process development \- throughout the product development life cycle. These engineers translate product requirements to product and project metrics and execute prototype bring\-up, integration, characterization, and product validation. The metrics are further used in product qualification and production testing. In lead roles, they remove roadblocks in new product development and provide technical advice to NPD leaders. **Essential Functions/ Responsibilities:** * Design and develop hybrid RF\-optics products, such as RF\-over\-fiber modules, optical transceivers, or photonic RF signal processors, optimizing for bandwidth, signal integrity, and power efficiency. * Knowledge in the RF and optical subsystems modeling and simulation result from tools like ADS, HFSS, or Zemax to predict performance and refine designs. * Understand the design of integrated RF components (e.g., amplifiers, mixers) with optical elements (e.g., modulators, photodetectors) to create cohesive, high\-functioning assemblies. * Perform hands\-on testing and validation of prototypes, using RF test equipment (e.g., network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, BERT) and optical tools (e.g., power meters, OTDRs, scope, VOA, optical switch). * Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to RF\-optical interactions, such as impedance matching, noise reduction, or optical loss. * Collaborate with product managers and manufacturing teams to ensure designs are scalable, cost\-effective, and compliant with industry standards (e.g., ITU, MIL\-STD). * Document design specifications, test procedures, and performance data to support development milestones and production transitions. * Research emerging RF\-optics technologies and materials to enhance product capabilities and maintain a competitive edge. *“The responsibilities as defined are intended to serve as a general guideline for this position. Associates may be asked to perform additional tasks depending on strengths and capabilities”***Required Skills and Experience:*** 4\+ years of experience in optoelectronic transceiver product design, with a focus on integrated RF\-optics systems. * Familiar with RF design tools (e.g., Keysight ADS, Ansys HFSS) and optical simulation software (e.g., Zemax, OptiSystem). * Hands\-on experience with RF and optical test equipment, including signal generators, vector network analyzers, BER tester, and optical spectrum analyzers. * Strong knowledge of RF principles (e.g., modulation, impedance, EMI) and optoelectronic concepts (e.g., fiber optics, laser diodes, dispersion). * Ability to analyze and solve complex technical challenges at the intersection of RF and optical domains. * Excellent organizational and communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration and technical documentation. * (Optional: Familiarity with specific applications, e.g., satellite communications, data center, 5G networks, or radar systems, if applicable.) **Education****:** Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Photonics, or a related field. **Salary** **and benefit offerings:** The preferred location for this position is the Silicon Valley Design Center in Santa Clara, CA. At this facility the salary range for this position would be in the range of $176 \- $220K per year and is commensurate with experience \+ plus generous Samtec bonuses paid three times per year in February, August and late fall. The secondary location would be the Samtec Vista design center in San Diego/Vista, CA. At this facility the salary range for this position would be in the range of $160 \- $200K per year and is commensurate with experience \+ plus generous Samtec bonuses paid three times per year in February, August and late fall. The third location would be the Samtec Microelectronics facility in Colorado Springs, CO. At this facility the salary range for this position would be in the range of $146 \- $182K per year and is commensurate with experience \+ plus generous Samtec bonuses paid three times per year in February, August and late fall. Samtec's generous benefits package includes medical (HSA/PPO) dental, vision, hearing, group life, AD\&D, short\- and long\-term disability, EAP, 401K match / profit sharing (Samtec will contribute 7% of your total gross pay to your 401(k) plan regardless of any contributions you make and will match the first 5% of your contribution to the 401(k)\-plan dollar for dollar), plus other voluntary options, as well as paid time off. **About Samtec:** Founded in 1976, Samtec is a privately held, $950 million global manufacturer of a broad line of electronic interconnect solutions, including High\-Speed Board\-to\-Board, High\-Speed Cables, Mid\-Board and Panel Optics, Precision RF, Flexible Stacking, and Micro/Rugged components and cables. Samtec Technology Centers are dedicated to developing and advancing technologies, strategies and products to optimize both the performance and cost of a system from the bare die to an interface 100 meters away, and all interconnect points in between. With 40\+ international locations and products sold in more than 125 different countries, Samtec’s global presence enables its unmatched customer service. Apply now if you have what it takes and are interested in joining Samtec’s vaunted culture, with competitive salaries and world\-class benefits.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology. **Job Description** **Full Stack Developer** **Locations:** Indiana, IN / Chicago, IL (Remote) **About the Role** The Skyline team builds SS\&C's property management platform \- leases, properties, accounting, payments and client reporting \- for customers in SS\&C's Insurance, Loan and Property business. We are hiring a Full Stack Developer to take on data transformation and full\-stack feature work across a NestJS/GraphQL backend and an Angular 18 frontend. You will build the pipelines that move data from MongoDB into the SQL models behind our analytics and client\-facing reports, and the services and screens that make that data usable. This is a hands\-on engineering role with real ownership of design and delivery, not ticket execution. **Why Join SS\&C** SS\&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence. You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real\-world operational challenges and large\-scale enterprise environments. **How You Will Make an Impact** * Build and maintain full\-stack features spanning our NestJS/GraphQL backend and Angular 18 frontend * Design and extend data transformation pipelines (MongoDB to SQL, using dbt) that feed reporting and analytics * Work across microservice boundaries \- service design, API contracts and data modeling * Contribute to Kubernetes\-deployed, cloud\-native infrastructure (Helm\-based deploys) alongside DevOps * Investigate and root\-cause data integrity issues in production and nonprod environments * Participate in architecture discussions and raise design and scalability concerns proactively \- we want engineers who ask whether a design will hold at scale before it ships * Pair with QA and product to close defects with an end\-to\-end fix rather than a symptom patch **Required Experience** * 5\+ years of full\-stack development experience (10\+ preferred), with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience * Strong backend experience with Node.js/NestJS, or comparable experience (.NET Core, Go) and a clear path to NestJS * Frontend experience with Angular (Angular 7 or later) * MongoDB or another document store, plus demonstrated comfort moving data into relational/SQL models * Microservice architecture and REST/GraphQL API design, plus Kubernetes and containerized deployment experience * Security implementation in application code \- authentication, permissions and data handling \- and ownership of a problem end to end: design, build, test, deploy, support * Hands\-on daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor): writing specs and prompts, directing an agent through multi\-step changes, and critically reviewing its output for correctness, security and team conventions before it ships **What Sets You Apart** (preferred qualifications) * dbt experience \- the team is moving MongoDB data into SQL models with it today * Angular 18 and Nx monorepo experience * Kubernetes certification such as CKAD * GraphQL specifically, as opposed to plain REST * CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and Helm chart authoring * A track record of root\-causing production data integrity issues * Prior work in property management, financial services or another regulated, data\-heavy domain Join SS\&C, where innovation meets global opportunities. Click here to apply. **\#LI\-PE1** **\#LI\-REMOTE** Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS\&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. SS\&C Technologies offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and future. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan with company match; paid time off, holidays, and parental leave; and professional development reimbursement opportunity. Actual base salary will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, prior experience, education, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Illinois: The expected base salary for the position is between 115,000 USD to 130,000 USD. In addition, employees in this role may be eligible for consideration on an annual basis for a discretionary bonus and/or equity awards, such as restricted stock units or stock options, based upon individual and business performance at the company’s discretion.### Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. SS\&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

jobs.description: **Department:** Strategy \& Governance **Location:** Sacramento, CA, US, 95827\-3824 **\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; } **Category:** Information Technology/Telecommunications **Minimum Pay Rate:** $110,801\.60 **Maximum Pay Rate:** $146,785\.60 **Civil Service Status:** Civil Service **Apply by Date:** 09/28/2026 **Posting Type:** Open The role of this Project Manager I position will be an Agile Release Train Engineer (RTE). The RTE is a servant leader and coach for an Agile Release Train (ART). They are responsible to facilitate the ART events and processes and assist the teams in delivering value. RTEs communicate with stakeholders, escalate impediments, help manage risk, and drive relentless improvement. The RTE will manage and optimize the flow of work through the ART, using various tools such as the Program Kanban, the Atlassian work management tools and other information channels. Specifically, the RTE is responsible for driving results to ensure the agile teams meet their PI Planning commitments by managing dependencies, hosting PO synch and the Scrum of Scrum ceremony. The RTE will manage the scrum master contractors under the MATOC agreement with oversight of the IT Supervisor. **Official SMUD Classification:** Project Manager I Purpose To provide leadership skills to plan, organize, and coordinate assigned projects. Establishing and maintaining cooperation between other work groups and the project. Integrating contract and District work groups on a project. Resolving technical issues. Nature and Scope Serves as a lead position with responsibility, appropriate authority and accountability to accomplish a given scope of work which extends across department lines, within the authorized budget and schedule. The Project Manager I, by controlling project activities through a matrix organization, is responsible for all work activities performed on the project. The Project Manager I requires moderate supervisory direction. This role typically oversees or leads smaller projects, or supports large complex projects with budgets of up to $1,000,000\. Duties and Responsibilities Develop Project Plans (PP) which define the scope, budget, schedule, and other resources of assigned projects. Support supervisor in obtaining Executive Management approvals of projects and assignments. Coordinate project resources as necessary to complete project tasks as long as total project costs do not exceed those within the approved Project Plan. Review and approve all requests for contract services or materials related to assigned projects. Ensure the proper and efficient use of District resources. Develop and maintain clear and concise communications and working relationships with other departments and projects that interface with the project. Provide input to project team members performance evaluations as a part of the annual SMUD performance evaluation process. Review and approve all project related contract and material invoices. Analyze cost/schedule trends and take appropriate corrective action when they are contrary to the Project Plan. Provide management with periodic updates on the status of assigned projects. Interface with external agency staff and contractor staff to resolve project conflicts. Perform related duties as required. Required Education A Bachelor’s of art or science degree or related discipline from accredited college or university or equivalent experience. jobs.description: Responsibilities: **WORK LOCATION: This position allows for a hybrid / flexible work schedule with a mix of work spent on site at the Sargent \& Lundy office in the Atlanta\-metro area of Peachtree Corners, Georgia and working remote from home.** The Electrical Analytical Division provides critical electrical analysis and consulting services supporting all S\&L power projects. This highly specialized team of power systems engineers collaborates closely with project teams and clients, delivering detailed electrical calculations, advanced studies, and tailored solutions for substation, transmission line, conventional power, nuclear, and renewable energy projects. Your work will have you perform the following types of studies:* Relay setting calculations * Power system calculations * Arc flash calculations * Cable ampacity calculations * Transient analysis * Harmonic analysis * Renewable energy calculations * Grounding and induction calculations There is the potential for you to travel to client offices and project sites to provide on\-site consultation. Valued but not required skills and experience:* Strong working knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, etc. * Successful completion of the Professional Engineering (PE) exam Technology \& Innovation: Sargent \& Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high\-quality outcomes for our clients. jobs.title: Founding Engineer (Dreamlever)
jobs.description: **DreamLever / MilesAI Inc. New York City preferred (Hybrid)** ### **Learn more** Visit our website at https://www.dreamlever.ai/ ### **About DreamLever** DreamLever is the AI a company shares. It learns the business through meeting conversations, connects what's happening across people, teams, and goals, and uses AI agents to move work forward. Founded by Brandon Katz, a former Chief of Staff who helped scale a company from 35 to more than 250 people, DreamLever turns firsthand experience building and running a company's management system into software. The product is live with paying customers, including a company with roughly 145 weekly active users across departments.Our external engineering partner, Scope Labs, helped build the product and continues to contribute, providing engineering support and knowledge of the existing system as we build our in\-house team. ### **The Role** As DreamLever's first in\-house engineer, you'll lead technical execution on a live, customer\-facing product. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you'll write code every day, make engineering decisions, and turn product priorities into polished software. You're energized by building and take pride in exceptional output. You'll work closely with the founder to understand the vision, translate detailed direction and prototypes into code, and move quickly from feedback to shipped improvements. Strong product judgment and UI/UX instincts help you resolve details, find efficient solutions, and deliver the intended customer experience. This is a close working relationship with the company's founder. Expect intensive working sessions—reviewing prototypes, debating product decisions, then moving straight into building. The founder leads the product and prototyping in detail; you decide how it gets built. You will own technical execution, drawing on the support of Scope Labs, our external engineering partner, whose team includes product managers, front\-end engineers, and full\-stack developers with deep knowledge of the existing system. You'll coordinate development with the founder, decide what to build autonomously and what to delegate to Scope Labs, and oversee execution to ensure we meet our product goals. ### **What You'll Do** * **Ship high\-impact product improvements quickly.** Build across the full stack, using coding agents effectively to accelerate development and ship well\-tested code daily. * **Turn product intent into working software.** Take founder direction, design prototypes, and detailed feedback through implementation and polish. Resolve gaps and edge cases, and verify that the finished experience achieves the intended customer outcome. * **Learn the existing system deeply and quickly.** Understand the architecture, integrations, data flows, and technical risks well enough to make sound decisions and confidently build upon a live codebase. * **Improve Miles's AI quality.** Develop how Miles, the DreamLever system's AI Chief of Staff agent, uses company context, evaluates information, and takes action. Evaluate its outputs, investigate failures, and iterate on usefulness and reliability. * **Drive coordinated, dependable delivery.** Break priorities into clear work, make realistic commitments, and communicate risks early. Direct and review work delegated to Scope Labs, our external development partner, and hold the line on quality and dates across the full development team. * **Contribute practical product ideas.** Bring creative solutions, strong UI/UX judgment, and ideas from software and productivity tools you know well. Use these insights to improve the customer experience. * **Keep the engineering foundation clear and reliable.** Maintain organized code, consistent naming, and useful documentation. Improve testing, observability, and deployment where they make development faster and safer. ### **Who You Are** **An exceptionally productive builder.** You love writing software and have a track record of shipping substantial production work quickly. You use coding agents fluently, manage multiple streams of work effectively, and take responsibility for the quality of the result. **Quick to understand, quick to execute.** You get oriented in unfamiliar codebases, grasp product intent, and turn direction into working software without extensive task\-by\-task instruction. You ask focused questions, get the context you need, and act decisively. **Focused on outcomes.** You understand what a change is supposed to accomplish for the customer, and follow through until the intended outcome is achieved. You are relentless about what matters, preferring to hit triples rather than polishing singles. When everything appears urgent, you can identify what actually is, and you don't sink time into details that won't move the product. You size up a problem and know how to attack it: what you own directly, what to delegate, and where your time is best spent. **Technically strong across the stack.** You can reason through backend systems, integrations, data models, asynchronous workflows, and user\-facing experiences. You investigate problems methodically, trace failures to their underlying causes, and make pragmatic decisions about speed, reliability, and maintainability. **Experienced with AI in production.** You've built LLM\-enabled features and understand how context, evaluation, and system design affect their quality. You're curious about failures and systematic about improving results. **Thoughtful about the user experience.** You care about making software simple, useful, and polished. You're interested in productivity tools and how people coordinate work, and bring practical ideas that strengthen the founder's vision. **Organized and dependable.** You keep your work understandable, communicate clearly, and make commitments you can keep. When delivery is at risk, you raise it early and help find a path forward. **Collaborative, direct, and receptive to feedback.** You enjoy working closely with an engaged founder. You contribute your perspective, take detailed feedback productively, and care more about a great result than whose idea gets implemented. **Energized by an early\-stage company's pace.** You want meaningful ownership and have the stamina to sustain a high level of output. You understand business goals and are committed to getting us to our next fundraising round, recognizing the importance of deadlines and maintaining pace to get there. ### **Qualifications** * Approximately 3–7 years of experience building and shipping production software, with meaningful ownership of features or systems from implementation through release. Bonus if you've started something of your own or been one of the first engineers at a small company. We're looking for evidence you've owned an outcome end to end rather than worked inside someone else's process. * Strong full\-stack engineering skills, including experience with APIs, integrations, asynchronous workflows, and data consistency. * Demonstrated ability to learn, extend, and improve an existing production codebase. * Hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-enabled features and using AI coding agents to accelerate development. Experience building agentic workflows and long\-running tasks is a plus. * Strong computer\-science fundamentals, whether developed through formal study or practical experience. * Experience working directly with founders, product leaders, or other non\-engineering stakeholders to turn product priorities into shipped software. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade\-offs to a wide array of technical and non\-technical collaborators, ensuring team alignment across the product and engineering function. * US\-based. New York City area strongly preferred; remote candidates will still be considered. * Experience and proficiency working with our current stack: TypeScript (Next.js \+ React), Postgres (Supabase). We care more about demonstrated ability, judgment, passion, and ownership than exact years of experience or résumé shape. If this sounds like your kind of work, we'd love to hear from you. ### **Compensation** Base salary: $170,000 to $200,000, depending on experience and demonstrated ability. This is a founding role with meaningful equity vesting over four years. ### **Americans with Disabilities Statement** Must be able to perform all essential functions of this position with reasonable accommodation. ### **EEO Statement** We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative, at all job levels, of the communities we serve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veterans' status, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

clear, concise, and objection\-ready. * **Process Discipline:** Methodical approach to pipeline hygiene, CRM activity tracking, and lead status management. * **No "AI\-Slop" Philosophy:** Skill in using AI tools for research and workflow automation while maintaining authentic, human\-to\-human communication. * **Collaboration:** Ability to work closely with SDR, Account Executives, Customer Success, and Marketing to execute joint account strategies. **Tech Stack You’ll Use** * **CRM:** Salesforce * **Outreach \& Messaging:** Outreach * **Enrichment \& Automation:** Clay, ZoomInfo, Apollo, Zapier, LLMs, etc * **Ecosystem \& Overlap:** Crossbeam * **Intelligence \& Research:** LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong / Chorus, RB2B, Vector, etc

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, AI Agents & Automation
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + ***Agentic depth:*** You've built or operated agents that autonomously monitor infrastructure and take action (e.g., an agent that watches system load and scales, remediates, or escalates without a human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. You can speak concretely to how these agents are actually built and operated (MCP protocol, what a harness is, how to differentiate agent\-design strategies rather than just naming tools), to context management (e.g., progressive\-disclosure strategies for surfacing the right information without dumping everything into context), and to securing agent actions (scoping authorization, guardrails, what's available in the AI infra ecosystem to enforce it). + ***SRE application:***That agentic work is pointed at infrastructure and reliability problems specifically — you use AI to move at a materially faster pace in the SRE domain, not as a general\-purpose coding aid. * SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions. * Cloud engineering \& networking: solid grounding in AWS or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing). * Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools. * CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system — GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable. * Programming: strong programming skills with the ability to build web applications — ideally with solid working knowledge of .NET and ASP.NET. We're also open to strong Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) backgrounds. The coding assessment will be tailored to whichever language/framework you're most comfortable in. * Experience with distributed systems and their common failure modes (retries, timeouts, cascading failures). * Strong production troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure. * 8\-10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience. * Nice\-to\-have: database experience (not mandatory — databases are monitored by the same team, not owned individually). **About You** You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade\-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger\-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.
